summary: Data-driven surrogate modeling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for accelerating computational fluid dynamics, and hierarchical U-shaped networks, which resemble the structure of classical Geometric Multigrid (GMG) methods, have become prevalent designs. Modern surrogates built on these designs achieve competitive accuracy at a fraction of the cost of numerical solvers; however, accurate prediction of complex flows remains challenging, and no existing architecture leads across them. In such networks, the multigrid analogy mainly concerns the multi-resolution topology, while their components largely follow common vision practice. To address this, this study introduces SUMNO, a multigrid neural operator for fluid flow fields on regular grids that spatially unrolls a V-cycle into a feed-forward U-shaped network. Parameter-free down- and upsampling stand in for restriction and prolongation, and additive skip connections for coarse-grid correction, with normalization-free transfer and skip pathways. Within this macro-architecture, convolutions are used at the fine and intermediate resolutions and shifted-window attention at the coarsest, whose window partitioning is generalized to handle periodicity independently per axis. Evaluated on unseen test configurations across four unsteady and steady flow benchmarks against five representative baselines, SUMNO is best in 5 of 7 settings and ranks second in the remaining two. It reduces the 10-step rollout MSE by about 30% relative to the strongest baseline, and outperforms three baselines with over 130 million parameters using 9.4 million parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SUMNO，一种将 V-cycle 展开为前馈 U 形网络的多重网格神经算子，用无参数下/上采样、加性跳跃连接和无归一化通路对齐多重网格组件，并在细/中分辨率用卷积、最粗层用按轴周期泛化的移位窗口注意力；在四个流动基准的未见配置上多数设置最优，且以 9.4M 参数取得显著误差降低。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动代理模型可加速计算流体力学，类多重网格的 U 形分层网络已成为常见设计，但复杂流场预测仍具挑战且没有单一架构全面领先；现有网络的多重网格类比主要限于多分辨率拓扑，组件多沿用通用视觉实践，因而需要更贴近多重网格机制的网络设计。
AI.method: 提出 SUMNO（多重网格神经算子），在规则网格上将 V-cycle 空间展开为前馈 U 形网络：以无参数下采样和上采样替代限制与延拓，以加性跳跃连接实现粗网格校正，并采用无归一化的传递与跳跃通路；宏观架构中，细分辨率和中间分辨率使用卷积，最粗分辨率使用移位窗口注意力，其窗口划分按各轴独立泛化以处理周期性。
AI.result: 在四个非定常与定常流动基准的未见测试配置上，与五个代表性基线比较，SUMNO 在 7 个设置中的 5 个最优、其余 2 个排名第二；相较最强基线将 10 步 rollout MSE 降低约 30%，并以 9.4M 参数优于三个参数量超过 130M 的基线。
AI.conclusion: SUMNO 通过将 U 形网络组件与多重网格操作更紧密对齐，在多个流动基准上表现出领先或接近领先的预测精度，并在显著更小参数量下优于大型基线，说明其兼具准确性与参数效率；摘要未提供更广泛的泛化性、计算成本细节或理论保证。

title: Enhancing optomechanical oscillation amplitude and frequency comb bandwidth by intensity-modulated driving
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. Main text: 11 pages, 5 figures. Appendices: 3 pages, 1 figure. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23735060
summary: Self-sustained oscillations in optomechanical systems are attractive as compact, low-noise sources of GHz signals and optical frequency combs for integrated photonic circuits. For these applications, the achievable oscillation amplitude directly sets clock power and comb bandwidth. This work studies the maximum amplitude that can be reached through combinations of cavity backaction and modulated optical driving, with realistic resources. For an optically driven mechanical resonator, the oscillation amplitude saturates at a level set by the finite cavity bandwidth. We show that modulating the input intensity near the mechanical resonance frequency raises the achievable amplitude toward this limit at equal mean input power and cavity linewidth. We use a cycle-averaged energy-balance analysis to identify the added power that shifts the stable periodic orbit to larger amplitudes. Numerical integration of the full equations of motion confirms the enhancement across two decades of cooperativity and sideband-resolution ratios from 0.1 to 10. The relative increase in amplitude is largest near the self-oscillation threshold and in the sideband-unresolved regime, enabling threshold-free large-amplitude oscillation where backaction alone fails to do so. The enhanced amplitude leads to a larger modulation depth of the optical field, enabling broader frequency combs, with improved stability of the comb spacing. Intensity-modulated driving thus offers power-constrained platforms a simple open-loop route to larger mechanical amplitudes and enhanced comb bandwidth.

AI.tldr: 该文研究光机械自持振荡在现实资源下可达到的最大振幅，指出振幅受有限腔带宽限制，并证明在相同平均输入功率和腔线宽下，将近机械共振频率的输入强度调制可把振幅推向该极限，从而获得更大机械振幅、更宽且间距更稳定的频率梳。
AI.motivation: 光机械自持振荡可作为集成光子电路中的紧凑、低噪声GHz信号源和光频梳，而可达振幅直接决定时钟功率和梳带宽，因此需要在现实资源条件下研究如何通过腔反作用与调制光驱动组合来提高振荡振幅。
AI.method: 采用周期平均能量平衡分析，识别使稳定周期轨道移向更大振幅所增加的功率；并对完整运动方程进行数值积分，在跨越两个数量级的协同度和0.1至10的边带分辨率比值范围内验证增强效果。
AI.result: 振荡振幅在有限腔带宽设定的水平饱和；在相同平均输入功率和腔线宽下，近机械共振频率调制输入强度可将可达振幅提高至接近该极限。相对振幅提升在自振荡阈值附近和边带未分辨区域最大，可在仅靠反作用无法实现时获得无阈值大振幅振荡；增强振幅带来更大的光场调制深度，从而支持更宽频率梳并改善梳间距稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 强度调制驱动为功率受限平台提供了一种简单的开环途径，以获得更大的机械振幅和增强的梳带宽。

title: Laser-Driven Electron Stripping from Nanoparticles in Plasma
summary: Laser wakefield accelerators use plasma wake waves to produce high-energy electron beams over short distances. Nanoparticles can trigger localized electron injection, with their size and density influencing the accelerated beam charge. However, the electron charge of a nanoparticle does not determine how much charge is stripped by the laser. Here we show that a quasistatic electrostatic model predicts laser-driven electron stripping from nanoparticles, in agreement with particle-in-cell simulations in vacuum and helium plasma. The model identifies a saturation density that increases with laser amplitude and decreases with nanoparticle radius, separating complete from partial stripping. Above this density, the stripped electron fraction decreases and the stripped charge approaches a finite limit. Multicycle pulses produce more stripped charge than the model predicts due to time-dependent electron dynamics. In helium plasma, plasma wake waves induce additional electron stripping. These results give an understanding of the scaling of laser-driven electron stripping from nanoparticles and could inform nanoparticle parameter selection for future nanoparticle-assisted laser wakefield accelerators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出准静态静电模型预测激光驱动纳米颗粒电子剥离，并与真空及氦等离子体中的粒子网格模拟一致；模型给出随激光振幅升高、纳米颗粒半径减小而增大的饱和密度，可区分完全剥离与部分剥离，并揭示多周期脉冲和等离子体尾波会带来额外剥离。
AI.motivation: 纳米颗粒可触发局域电子注入，其尺寸和密度影响加速束电荷，但纳米颗粒自身电子电荷并不能决定激光剥离多少电荷，因此需要理解激光驱动纳米颗粒电子剥离的标度规律，为纳米颗粒辅助激光尾场加速器的参数选择提供依据。
AI.method: 建立准静态静电模型预测激光驱动纳米颗粒的电子剥离，并在真空和氦等离子体中与粒子网格（PIC）模拟结果进行对比。
AI.result: 模型预测与真空及氦等离子体中的PIC模拟一致；识别出随激光振幅增加而升高、随纳米颗粒半径减小而降低的饱和密度，该密度区分完全剥离与部分剥离；高于该密度时，被剥离电子比例下降，剥离电荷趋近有限极限；多周期脉冲因时间依赖的电子动力学产生比模型预测更多的剥离电荷；在氦等离子体中，等离子体尾波会诱导额外电子剥离。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了激光驱动纳米颗粒电子剥离的标度认识，可用于指导未来纳米颗粒辅助激光尾场加速器中的纳米颗粒参数选择。

title: Edge-scaling softening of a universal machine-learned potential: point-defect formation energies in a coronene graphene quantum dot
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Presented at ADT-ISMDDC-2026 (ICST-ODESA-2026), Odesa, Ukraine, September 22-24, 2026. To appear in CEUR Workshop Proceedings
summary: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are increasingly used as computationally efficient surrogates for density functional theory (DFT) in high-throughput nanomaterials screening. Systematic softening has been reported for several universal MLIPs when high-energy and far-from-equilibrium configurations are underrepresented in training data. We examine how this behavior appears at under-coordinated edge sites in graphene quantum dots (GQDs), where a vacancy can have pronounced molecular-radical character. Using coronene (C$_{24}$H$_{12}$), a hexagonal GQD with $D_{6h}$ symmetry and three carbon classes, we benchmark SevenNet (7net-omni-i12) against spin-polarized PBE DFT (GPAW) for monovacancy, divacancy, and Stone-Wales defects. Beyond the full site- and bond-resolved landscapes, we perform a controlled matched-reconstruction comparison in which 28 vacancy and divacancy configurations are scored by both engines using self-consistent chemical-potential reservoirs. In this dataset, SevenNet underestimates all 28 vacancy and divacancy formation energies, and the mean deficit increases with under-coordination within each defect family: 0.30-0.74 eV for monovacancies and 0.65-1.11 eV for divacancies as the number of broken edge C-H bonds increases. By contrast, the mean Stone-Wales energies differ by only 0.013 eV. SevenNet also preserves the ordering of three hydrogen-dependent reconstruction basins and reproduces $D_{6h}$-equivalent sites to within a few meV. The within-class symmetry spread therefore provides a practical diagnostic of basin-sensitive relaxations. Within the present coronene benchmark, these results support MLIP-based structure screening and preliminary ranking, while absolute vacancy energies and multi-basin edge configurations still require DFT validation.

AI.tldr: 该文以 coronene（C24H12）为石墨烯量子点模型，用自旋极化 PBE DFT（GPAW）基准检验 SevenNet（7net-omni-i12）对单空位、双空位和 Stone-Wales 缺陷的预测，发现 SevenNet 系统性低估 28 个空位/双空位形成能，且欠配位越强偏差越大，但 Stone-Wales 能量与对称性相关排序保持较好。
AI.motivation: 通用机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）常被用作 DFT 的高效替代以进行高通量纳米材料筛选，但已有报道显示其在训练数据中高能、远离平衡构型不足时会出现系统性软化。作者关注石墨烯量子点欠配位边缘位点，尤其是空位可能具有显著分子自由基特征的情形，以检验该软化如何在边缘缺陷中体现。
AI.method: 使用具有 D6h 对称性和三类碳位的六方石墨烯量子点 coronene（C24H12），将 SevenNet（7net-omni-i12）与自旋极化 PBE DFT（GPAW）进行基准比较，覆盖单空位、双空位和 Stone-Wales 缺陷。除全位点和键分辨的能量景观外，还进行受控的匹配重构比较：用自洽化学势储层由两种引擎共同评分 28 个空位和双空位构型。
AI.result: 在该数据集中，SevenNet 低估全部 28 个空位和双空位形成能；在每个缺陷族内，平均亏缺随欠配位程度增加：单空位为 0.30–0.74 eV，双空位为 0.65–1.11 eV（随断裂边缘 C–H 键数量增加）。相比之下，Stone-Wales 平均能量仅相差 0.013 eV。SevenNet 还保持了三个氢依赖重构盆地的顺序，并将 D6h 等价位点重现到几 meV 以内；类内对称性展布可作为盆地敏感弛豫的实用诊断指标。
AI.conclusion: 在本 coronene 基准范围内，结果支持基于 MLIP 的结构筛选和初步排序，但绝对空位能量及多盆地边缘构型仍需 DFT 验证。

title: Shallow water equations on n-dimensional Riemannian manifolds: a kinetic approach
summary: We develop an intrinsic kinetic moment closure for shallow-water equations on smooth manifolds of arbitrary dimension equipped with prescribed, possibly time-dependent Riemannian metrics. Hamiltonian transport on the cotangent bundle and metric-dependent momentum integration yield balance laws with hydrostatic pressure, bottom topography, a skew-adjoint force, and dissipative bottom friction. An explicit compactly supported Gibbs equilibrium satisfies the required mass, momentum, and tensor second-moment conditions. We derive the quasilinear formulation and characteristic speeds, establish the continuous mechanical-energy balance with geometric work and frictional dissipation, and obtain a weak entropy inequality for vanishing-viscosity limits under stated convergence assumptions. On the rotating sphere with a fixed round metric, the skew-adjoint force represents Coriolis effects. We construct a kinetic finite-volume scheme combining local fluxes, hydrostatic reconstruction, and geometric source terms. A second-order time integrator uses independently restricted steps at its two Euler stages. The scheme conserves discrete water volume, preserves nonnegative depth under a sufficient CFL condition, and is well balanced for lakes at rest, including wet/dry interfaces. Six-hour simulations of a localized surface disturbance over Earth topography with Manning bottom friction maintain positive depths and conserve water volume to near machine precision. Comparison with a spherical central-upwind method shows similar surface-wave propagation and gauge time series, with remaining differences in late-time local extrema.

AI.tldr: 该文提出任意维光滑流形上浅水方程的内在动理学矩封闭，推导含几何源项、底摩阻和能量/熵性质的模型，并构造守恒、保正、良平衡的动理学有限体积格式，在球面地球地形算例中验证。
AI.motivation: 摘要未直接陈述研究动机；其目标是针对具有预设且可能随时间变化的 Riemann 度量的任意维光滑流形，建立浅水方程的内在动理学矩封闭，并同时处理几何力、底地形、底摩阻、能量耗散及数值上的守恒、保正和良平衡性质。
AI.method: 采用余切丛上的 Hamilton 输运和依赖度量的动量积分得到含静水压、底地形、斜伴随力和耗散底摩阻的平衡律；构造满足质量、动量和张量二阶矩条件的紧支撑 Gibbs 平衡态；推导拟线性形式与特征速度，建立含几何功和摩擦耗散的连续机械能平衡，并在给定收敛假设下得到消失黏性极限的弱熵不等式；在固定圆度量的旋转球面上将斜伴随力解释为 Coriolis 效应；数值上构造结合局部通量、静水重构和几何源项的动理学有限体积格式，二阶时间积分器在两个 Euler 阶段采用独立限制步长。
AI.result: 理论结果包括平衡律、Gibbs 平衡态、拟线性形式与特征速度、连续机械能平衡及弱熵不等式；格式在充分 CFL 条件下守恒离散水量、保持水深非负，并对静水湖泊（含干湿界面）良平衡。地球地形上带 Manning 底摩阻的六小时局部水面扰动模拟保持正水深，水量守恒接近机器精度；与球面中心迎风格式相比，表面波传播和验潮时间序列相似，但晚期局部极值仍有差异。
AI.conclusion: 摘要表明，该内在动理学矩封闭与动理学有限体积格式能够在流形几何框架下兼顾理论能量/熵性质与数值守恒、保正和良平衡；算例支持其实际可行性，并与参考格式总体一致，但晚期局部极值差异尚存，摘要未给出进一步定量结论或收敛阶。

title: Chlorophyll-a Fluorescence-Based Optical Temperature Sensor Using Food-Grade Chlorella Extract
summary: This letter reports the development of an optical temperature sensor based on the fluorescence of an extract obtained from \textit{Chlorella}, a unicellular microalga commercially available as food-grade biomass. Using a straightforward ethanolic extraction route, the sensing platform exploits the characteristic emission of chlorophyll-\textit{a} as the optical transducing parameter. The operating principle relies on thermal fluorescence quenching, which promotes a decrease in emission intensity with rising temperature. In the temperature range from $28.6$ to $43.0~^{\circ}\text{C}$, the sensor exhibited a linear response ($R^2 = 0.9963$) with a sensitivity of $(-8.9 \pm 0.2) \times 10^{-3}~^{\circ}\text{C}^{-1}$. Dynamic testing over consecutive heating--cooling cycles confirmed the sensor operation under sub-degree thermal oscillations and enabled the characterization of the system's photobleaching drift ($3.65\%\cdot\text{h}^{-1}$). The results reported herein demonstrate the feasibility of exploiting sustainable, bio-derived microalgal pigments as functional photoactive materials for optical thermometry.

AI.tldr: 本文报道一种基于小球藻乙醇提取物中叶绿素-a荧光热猝灭的光学温度传感器，在28.6–43.0 °C范围内实现线性响应，灵敏度为(-8.9 ± 0.2) × 10^-3 °C^-1，并表征了动态升降温响应及光漂白漂移。
AI.motivation: 探索可持续、生物来源的微藻色素作为功能性光活性材料用于光学测温，并利用商品化食品级小球藻生物质开发荧光温度传感器。
AI.method: 采用简便的乙醇提取路线从Chlorella获得提取物，以叶绿素-a的特征发射作为光学转导参数，基于温度升高导致荧光强度下降的热荧光猝灭原理工作；在28.6–43.0 °C范围内测试线性响应，并通过连续加热–冷却循环进行动态测试，同时表征体系的光漂白漂移。
AI.result: 传感器在28.6–43.0 °C范围内呈线性响应，R^2 = 0.9963，灵敏度为(-8.9 ± 0.2) × 10^-3 °C^-1；动态测试确认其可在亚摄氏度热振荡下工作，光漂白漂移为3.65%·h^-1。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，利用可持续、生物来源的微藻色素作为功能性光活性材料进行光学测温是可行的；摘要未提供更宽温度范围、长期稳定性或选择性等数据。

title: SFQED Cascade Saturation and Laser Depletion Dynamics In CP Rotating Laser Standing Waves
summary: Multi-petawatt laser facilities are approaching the regime where colliding laser pulses can spontaneously ignite self-sustained QED cascades, converting laser energy into dense electron-positron plasmas. Using 1D PIC-QED simulations of a circularly polarized standing wave, we characterize the complete lifecycle of seeded cascades from exponential growth through relativistic opacity and macroscopic laser depletion. We show that cascade saturation is governed by the competition between pair creation and longitudinal lepton migration out of the magnetic nodes. The overdense plasma reflects the driving laser, disrupting the standing wave and triggering secondary cascades in adjacent nodes, driving an apparent spatial expansion whose velocity scales linearly with the cascade growth rate. Finally, we generalize an analytical laser absorption model to realistic time-dependent pulse envelopes, accurately reproducing the simulated conversion efficiency of laser energy into gamma-ray photons and electron-positron pairs.

AI.tldr: 该文利用一维PIC-QED模拟研究圆偏振驻波中种子QED级联的完整生命周期，揭示饱和由对产生与纵向轻子迁出磁节点之间的竞争决定，并给出可复现激光能量转化为伽马光子和正负电子对效率的解析吸收模型。
AI.motivation: 多拍瓦激光设施正接近这样的参数区间：相向激光脉冲可自发点燃自持QED级联，并将激光能量转化为致密电子-正电子等离子体；因此需要刻画种子级联从增长到饱和、激光耗尽及能量转换的完整过程。
AI.method: 采用一维粒子模拟结合量子电动力学（1D PIC-QED）模拟圆偏振驻波中的种子级联，覆盖指数增长、相对论不透明和宏观激光耗尽阶段；并将激光吸收解析模型推广到现实的时间依赖脉冲包络。
AI.result: 级联饱和由对产生与纵向轻子迁出磁节点之间的竞争控制；过密等离子体反射驱动激光、破坏驻波并在相邻磁节点触发次级级联，导致表观空间扩展，其速度随级联增长率线性变化；推广后的吸收模型能准确复现模拟中激光能量转化为伽马光子和电子-正电子对的效率。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了种子QED级联从指数增长经相对论不透明到宏观激光耗尽的完整生命周期图像，阐明了饱和机制、激光反射与次级级联驱动的空间扩展，并表明推广的解析吸收模型可用于现实脉冲包络下的能量转化效率预测。

title: TARANG: an open-source, cost-controlled design workflow for silicon nitride microcomb chips
summary: Designing a microresonator frequency comb chip means solving a chain of coupled problems: a waveguide with anomalous dispersion that survives fabrication errors, a ring with the right free spectral range and quality factor, a bus gap that sets the coupling regime, and grating couplers, all made in one lithography step. We present TARANG, an open-source Python package that takes a silicon nitride platform from tabulated refractive indices to a GDSII mask in fourteen stages, built on the Tidy3D mode, FDTD and eigenmode-expansion solvers. Every cloud simulation is priced before it runs and capped, every result is cached by a fingerprint of the full simulation, and every quoted number carries a numerical check. We show that snapping the grid onto the core's faces, a common way to steady dispersion calculations, leaves the field samples on the faces to floating-point rounding, and that averaging solves with the grid just inside and just outside the faces makes the group-velocity dispersion $D$ independent of the computer and steady to about 1 ps/(nm km) from mesh to mesh. Two complete air-clad designs are presented, at 1550 nm ($700\times1000$ nm core, $D = 372.9 \pm 0.6$ ps/(nm km)) and at 780 nm ($350\times500$ nm, $D = 196.4 \pm 0.9$ ps/(nm km)), each with a 200 GHz ring, critical and over-coupled gaps, grating couplers, and a fibre-to-fibre budget. The predicted dispersion agrees with two measured devices from the literature to within 1 and 4%, and an independent Lugiato-Lefever solver forms stable single solitons from the exported parameters of both designs, which are ready for fabrication.

AI.tldr: TARANG 是一个开源 Python 工具链，可将氮化硅微谐振腔频率梳芯片从材料折射率数据自动设计到 GDSII 版图，共 14 个阶段；它基于 Tidy3D 求解器，提供仿真成本预估与上限、完整仿真指纹缓存及数值校验。论文还给出网格处理方案和两个可直接制造的完整设计。
AI.motivation: 微谐振腔频率梳芯片设计涉及一系列相互耦合的问题：需同时满足抗制造误差的异常色散波导、合适自由光谱范围与品质因子的环、设定耦合状态的总线间隙以及光栅耦合器，并在同一步光刻中实现。因此需要一套可复现、数值可靠且成本可控的端到端设计流程。
AI.method: 提出开源 Python 包 TARANG，基于 Tidy3D 的模式、FDTD 和本征模展开求解器，将氮化硅平台从表格化折射率推进到 GDSII 掩模，共 14 个阶段。每次云仿真运行前估价并设上限，结果按完整仿真指纹缓存，引用数值均带数值检查。针对将网格对齐到芯层界面的常见做法，指出界面场采样受浮点舍入影响；采用网格略在界面内和略在界面外的两次求解取平均，使群速度色散 D 不依赖计算机，并在网格间稳定约 1 ps/(nm km)。
AI.result: 给出两个完整的空气包层设计：1550 nm 设计采用 700×1000 nm 芯层，D = 372.9 ± 0.6 ps/(nm km)；780 nm 设计采用 350×500 nm 芯层，D = 196.4 ± 0.9 ps/(nm km)。两者均包含 200 GHz 环、临界与过耦合间隙、光栅耦合器及光纤到光纤预算。预测色散与文献中两个实测器件的偏差分别在 1% 和 4% 以内；独立的 Lugiato–Lefever 求解器利用两个设计导出的参数形成稳定单孤子，设计已可制造。
AI.conclusion: TARANG 提供了从材料数据到版图、带成本控制与数值可复现性保障的微谐振腔频率梳芯片设计流程；其色散计算方法稳健，两个设计经文献测量对比和独立孤子仿真验证，具备制造准备度。

title: Lifetime of localized turbulence in transitional channel flow
summary: The lifetime of localized turbulence in transitional channel flow, the so-called turbulent stripes or bands, as a function of the Reynolds number ($Re$) is reported here. Recent studies showed that although the mean lifetime of a turbulent band increases with the band length, it appears to saturate at a certain critical length, which is smaller than the fully developed band length. However, this observation was based on a single Reynolds number only. Here, we first confirmed this saturation by considering higher Reynolds numbers. This property enables us to measure the characteristic lifetime of a turbulent band without having to resolve it at its full length, which greatly reduces the computational cost and makes statistical studies by direct numerical simulation (DNS) feasible near the lower end of the transitional-$Re$ regime. Subsequently, by extensive DNS, we measured the lifetime up to $Re=670$, and the data cover more than two orders of magnitude, ranging from $O(10^2)$ to nearly $O(10^5)$ and revealing a sharp but smooth growth with increasing $Re$. No sudden divergence of the lifetime was observed in the $Re$ range investigated, in which controversy existed over whether or not a turbulent band would become sustained. Despite significant differences between the structure and dynamics of channel bands and pipe puffs, our data concretely support a unified transition scenario in the two flows.

AI.tldr: 本文通过直接数值模拟研究过渡态槽道流中局域湍流带（湍流条纹）的寿命随雷诺数的变化，确认有限长度带的平均寿命会在小于完全发展带长的临界长度处饱和，并据此以较低计算成本测量至Re=670的寿命；结果显示寿命从约10^2增长到接近10^5，呈陡峭但平滑的增长，未观察到突然发散，并支持槽道流湍流带与管流湍流团统一的过渡场景。
AI.motivation: 已有研究仅基于单一雷诺数观察到湍流带平均寿命随带长增加而饱和于小于完全发展带长的临界长度，结论的代表性不足；同时，过渡态雷诺数范围内湍流带是否会变为持续存在尚有争议，因此需要系统测量湍流带寿命随雷诺数的变化。
AI.method: 在高雷诺数下验证湍流带寿命随带长增加的饱和现象；利用该饱和性质，在不解析完全发展带长的情况下测量湍流带的特征寿命，从而降低计算成本；随后通过大量直接数值模拟（DNS）测量湍流带寿命，最高达到Re=670。
AI.result: 确认了湍流带平均寿命随带长增加而饱和的现象；测得的寿命数据覆盖超过两个数量级，从O(10^2)到接近O(10^5)；寿命随Re增加呈陡峭但平滑的增长；在所研究的Re范围内未观察到寿命的突然发散。
AI.conclusion: 尽管槽道流中的湍流带与管流中的湍流团在结构和动力学上存在显著差异，本文数据具体支持这两种流动中存在统一的过渡场景。

title: Inverse Design of an On-chip Phase-Change Switch Composed of Sparse Heterogeneous Metasurfaces
summary: Photonic switches are exploited for optical signal routing and control within optical communication systems. The integration of phase change materials with silicon photonic switches overcomes the drawbacks of the state-of-the-art photonic switches based on electro-optic and thermo-optic effects. In this work, a 1x2 on-chip switch with a footprint of 6.3umx31um based on on-chip one-dimensional metasurfaces is inverse-designed. The on-chip metasurfaces are heterogeneous, which their meta-atoms can be composed of either SiO2 or the phase-change material Sb2Se3. This helps to the realization of higher extinction ratio between the switch outputs, especially at the amorphous state which has a small refractive index contrast to that of the silicon. To benefit from structural, fabrication and switching simplicity, sparse parameterization is followed in the inverse design of the switch using ternary search (TS) and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文逆设计了一种基于片上一维异质超表面的硅基1×2开关，尺寸为6.3 μm×31 μm；超原子由SiO2或相变材料Sb2Se3构成，并采用三元搜索与粒子群优化进行稀疏参数化设计，以提升输出间消光比并简化结构、制造和切换。摘要未给出定量性能结果。
AI.motivation: 将相变材料与硅光子开关集成，以克服现有基于电光效应和热光效应的光子开关的缺点；同时借助异质超表面提高开关输出间的消光比，尤其是在与硅折射率对比度较小的非晶态下。
AI.method: 逆设计片上1×2开关，采用片上一维超表面，其异质超原子可由SiO2或相变材料Sb2Se3组成；为兼顾结构、制造和切换的简单性，采用稀疏参数化，并结合三元搜索（TS）和粒子群优化（PSO）算法进行逆设计。
AI.result: 摘要仅报道了所设计开关的 footprint 为6.3 μm×31 μm，以及异质超表面有助于实现更高消光比的设计主张；未提供插入损耗、消光比数值、切换速度或实验测量等定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出并逆设计了一种基于SiO2/Sb2Se3异质一维超表面的硅基1×2片上光子开关，旨在利用相变材料与稀疏优化提升消光比并简化结构、制造和切换；具体性能结论需依据摘要未提供的定量与实验数据进一步验证。

title: Impurity turbulent transport and its role in driving zonal flows in tokamak plasmas
summary: The driving mechanisms of zonal flows (ZFs) in multi-ion-species tokamak plasmas are investigated by using gyrokinetic theory and simulations. For deuterium plasmas containing either helium ash with a steep density gradient or lithium impurity at a high charge concentration, the magnitude of impurity turbulent energy flux (TEF) can be comparable to, or even stronger than, that of the main-ion TEF. Moreover, the impurity TEF significantly drives ZFs. Both the impurity and main-ion turbulent poloidal Reynolds stress (PRS) drives are significant for the case with a high lithium charge concentration. The shielding timescale of the turbulent PRS drive is found to be the damping time of geodesic acoustic mode, which is significantly shorter than one ion bounce period.

AI.tldr: 采用回旋动理学理论与模拟研究多离子种托卡马克等离子体中带状流（ZF）的驱动机制，发现杂质湍流能量通量（TEF）可与主离子相当甚至更强，并可显著驱动ZF；高锂电荷浓度下杂质与主离子湍流极向雷诺应力（PRS）驱动均重要，PRS驱动的屏蔽时间尺度为测地声模（GAM）阻尼时间，远短于一个离子弹跳周期。
AI.motivation: 研究多离子种托卡马克等离子体中ZF的驱动机制，重点考察含陡密度梯度氦灰或高电荷浓度锂杂质时，杂质TEF、杂质与主离子PRS驱动以及湍流PRS驱动的屏蔽时间尺度所起的作用。
AI.method: 基于回旋动理学理论和模拟，针对含氦灰陡密度梯度或高电荷浓度锂杂质的氘等离子体，分析杂质与主离子的TEF、湍流PRS驱动及屏蔽时间尺度。
AI.result: 杂质TEF幅值可与主离子TEF相当甚至更强，且杂质TEF显著驱动ZF；在高锂电荷浓度情形下，杂质和主离子的湍流PRS驱动均显著；湍流PRS驱动的屏蔽时间尺度为GAM阻尼时间，显著短于一个离子弹跳周期。摘要未给出具体数值、参数范围或定量标度。
AI.conclusion: 多离子种等离子体中杂质TEF和湍流PRS驱动是ZF驱动的重要机制；湍流PRS驱动的屏蔽由GAM阻尼控制，且发生在远短于离子弹跳周期的时间尺度上。摘要未提供定量预测或实验验证结论。

title: Stable ring-polymer molecular dynamics without Fourier transforms: a linear-scaling bead-space Cayley propagator
summary: Ring-polymer molecular dynamics (RPMD) builds zero-point energy and tunnelling into classical trajectories and is widely used for bimolecular rate coefficients. At low temperature it requires many beads, and the stiff ring-polymer springs then limit the integrator. The Cayley modification of the free ring-polymer step removes this limit, but it has so far been formulated mode by mode, which requires Fourier transforms of every degree of freedom at every step. Here we show that, in bead coordinates, the Cayley step reduces to one cyclic tridiagonal solve for the midpoint of the step, with a matrix that depends only on the number of beads $P$, the temperature and the time step, and not on the atomic masses. The bead-space step is exactly the normal-mode Cayley map: it conserves the free ring-polymer energy, preserves the free ring-polymer Boltzmann distribution, and is stable for any $P$ whenever $ΩΔt<2$ for the highest physical frequency $Ω$. A Thomas recursion with a rank-two Woodbury correction solves it in about $18P$ operations per degree of freedom without pivoting, with a condition number bounded by $1+(ω_PΔt)^2$, and the inverse matrix decays geometrically with bead separation, so the step is local in bead index. Implemented in the open-source PyRPMD package, the propagator reproduces normal-mode Cayley to $1.5\times10^{-15}$ for up to 2048 beads and its cost grows linearly with $P$. For direct RPMD (dRPMD), which has so far integrated the springs explicitly, these properties raise the stability limit on the time step 23--29-fold in published low-temperature settings; at \SI{20}{K} with 3072 beads, the Cayley step conserves the ring-polymer energy as well as velocity Verlet does with a time step about ten times larger, while leaving the low-lying internal modes that govern spurious resonances essentially unchanged.

AI.tldr: 该文将RPMD中原本按简正模实施的Cayley自由环聚合物积分步改写为珠坐标下的单次循环三对角求解，在保持与简正模Cayley映射严格等价的同时，实现线性于珠数的成本，并显著放宽dRPMD的时间步稳定性限制。
AI.motivation: 低温RPMD需要大量珠数，刚性环聚合物弹簧会严重限制积分器步长；Cayley修正虽能消除该限制，但此前按简正模逐模构造，每一步都要对所有自由度做Fourier变换，计算开销大。作者因此希望在珠坐标中高效实现等价的Cayley步。
AI.method: 作者证明在珠坐标下，Cayley步可化为对步中点的单次循环三对角求解，其矩阵只依赖珠数P、温度和时间步长，不依赖原子质量。该珠空间步与简正模Cayley映射严格等价，守恒自由环聚合物能量、保持自由环聚合物Boltzmann分布，并在最高物理频率Ω满足ΩΔt<2时对任意P稳定。求解采用Thomas递推加秩二Woodbury修正，每自由度约18P次运算、无需选主元；条件数上界为1+(ω_PΔt)^2，逆矩阵随珠索引间隔几何衰减，因此该步在珠索引上具有局域性。方法已实现在开源PyRPMD包中。
AI.result: 该传播子对多达2048个珠与简正模Cayley的结果一致到1.5×10^-15，成本随P线性增长。对此前显式积分弹簧的direct RPMD（dRPMD），在已发表低温设置中把时间步稳定性上限提高23–29倍；在20 K、3072个珠时，Cayley步的能量守恒与速度Verlet在约10倍大的时间步下相当，同时决定虚假共振的低能内部模基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 珠空间Cayley传播子为RPMD提供了一种严格等价、线性标度、数值稳定且珠局域的积分方案，可显著增大dRPMD的可用时间步并已集成于PyRPMD；摘要未提供其他真实化学体系的系统精度或成本基准。

title: A linear stability method based on generalized hydrodynamics: application to high-speed plane Couette flow beyond continuum regime
summary: Linear stability analysis of compressible shear flows beyond continuum regime attracts increasing attention in recent years accounting for high-altitude applications. In this paper, the temporal stability of high-speed plane Couette flow in near-continuum regime is addressed. A novel linear stability method based on the generalized hydrodynamic equations (GHE) with slip boundary conditions is developed within the 13-moment framework. Meanwhile, the linear stability equations of the nonlinear coupled constitutive relations (NCCR) and the Navier--Stokes (NS) equations are also given. Based on the developed methods, the linear stability of plane Couette flows at $Ma=2.5$--10 and $Kn=2.7\times 10^{-5}$--0.07 are analyzed, and the rarefaction effects on the base flow, eigenspectrum, mode synchronization and least stable mode are investigated. The results show that the GHE with slip boundary conditions agrees well with direct simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) results in predicting base flow profiles of velocity, temperature, all stress and heat flux components, while the NS equations show considerable differences, especially for capturing the nonlinear normal stress and tangential heat flux. The GHE-based linear stability theory (LST) recovers to the classical NS-based LST in the continuum limit, while they show considerable differences when $Kn$ reaches $O(0.01)$. As rarefaction degree increases, the synchronization between acoustic modes and viscous modes becomes weak, and all modes become stable in rarefied plane Couette flow. The surface slip effect and nonlinear transport increase the disturbance phase speeds, while they have different effects on the growth rate of different modes. Generally, rarefaction effects increase the growth rate of the least stable Mode II at low wavenumbers, and show more pronounced effects on higher modes and high-wavenumber disturbances.

AI.tldr: 本文针对近连续区高速平面库埃特流，建立基于13矩广义流体动力学方程并采用滑移边界条件的线性稳定性方法，同时给出NCCR与Navier–Stokes方程的线性稳定性方程；在Ma=2.5–10、Kn=2.7×10^-5–0.07范围内分析稀薄效应对基流、特征谱、模态同步及最不稳定模态的影响。
AI.motivation: 高空应用使超越连续区的可压缩剪切流线性稳定性分析受到越来越多关注；本文旨在研究近连续区高速平面库埃特流的时间稳定性，并刻画稀薄效应对其稳定性特征的影响。
AI.method: 在13矩框架内建立基于广义流体动力学方程（GHE）并含滑移边界条件的线性稳定性方法，同时给出非线性耦合本构关系（NCCR）和Navier–Stokes（NS）方程的线性稳定性方程；据此计算Ma=2.5–10、Kn=2.7×10^-5–0.07的平面库埃特流，考察稀薄效应对基流、特征谱、模态同步和最不稳定模态的作用。
AI.result: 含滑移边界条件的GHE在预测速度、温度、各应力分量和热流分量的基流剖面方面与DSMC吻合良好，而NS方程存在明显差异，尤其在非线性法向应力和切向热流方面。GHE线性稳定性理论在连续极限下退化为经典NS线性稳定性理论，但当Kn达到O(0.01)时二者差异显著。随着稀薄度增加，声学模态与黏性模态之间的同步减弱，稀薄平面库埃特流中所有模态趋于稳定；表面滑移效应和非线性输运提高扰动相速度，但对不同模态增长率影响不同。总体而言，稀薄效应在低波数下提高最不稳定Mode II的增长率，并对更高阶模态和高波数扰动影响更明显。
AI.conclusion: 基于GHE并考虑滑移边界条件的线性稳定性方法能够较好描述近连续区高速平面库埃特流的基流与稳定性特征，并揭示稀薄效应对模态同步、相速度和增长率的影响；NS方程在Kn达到O(0.01)时与GHE结果差异明显，表明近连续区需采用更精细的广义流体动力学建模。摘要未给出具体临界稳定性参数或定量增长率数值。

title: Ultracompact and Nonvolatile On-chip Switch Based on DBS and PSO Algorithms
summary: A 1x2 photonic switch based on silicon-on-insulator (SOI)-Sb2Se3 hybrid platform is inverse-designed using direct binary search (DBS) and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithms. The nonvolatile on-chip switch is designed to consist of minimum switchable phase-change units and operates based on the en-masse switching of all Sb2Se3 cells from crystalline to amorphous and vice-versa. The device has a small footprint of only 6.3umx31um. At the wavelength of 1550nm, it exhibits an insertion loss of less than 0.96dB, and its crosstalk is measured to be less than -12dB within the three-dimensional (3D) finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations.

AI.tldr: 基于SOI-Sb2Se3混合平台，采用直接二进制搜索（DBS）与粒子群优化（PSO）逆设计了一个1×2非易失光子开关；该器件由最少可切换相变单元构成，通过全部Sb2Se3单元在晶态与非晶态之间整体切换工作，尺寸仅6.3μm×31μm，在1550nm处插损小于0.96dB，3D FDTD仿真中串扰小于-12dB。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确说明研究动机，仅指出设计对象为非易失片上1×2光子开关，并强调采用最少可切换相变单元及整体切换工作方式。
AI.method: 采用基于SOI-Sb2Se3混合平台的逆设计方法，结合直接二进制搜索（DBS）和粒子群优化（PSO）算法设计1×2光子开关；器件由最少可切换相变单元构成，利用所有Sb2Se3单元从晶态到非晶态及反向的整体切换实现开关操作，并采用三维有限差分时域（3D FDTD）仿真评估性能。
AI.result: 器件 footprint 为6.3μm×31μm；在1550nm波长下，插入损耗小于0.96dB，3D FDTD仿真中串扰小于-12dB。
AI.conclusion: 摘要表明该逆设计SOI-Sb2Se3混合平台1×2非易失光子开关具有紧凑尺寸，并在1550nm处呈现低插入损耗和低串扰的仿真结果；摘要未提供更进一步的结论性表述。

title: Cross-channel amplification of frequency-distinct scattered waves in multibeam stimulated Brillouin scattering
summary: Multibeam stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) can be amplified when one side-scattered wave draws energy from several pumps, each through a separate ion-acoustic-wave (IAW) branch. This is not common-daughter-wave coupling: scattered waves from different parent pumps may occupy nearly the same wave-vector region yet remain distinct optical modes because their frequencies differ. We examine this process with local-growth and finite-width-gain models, three-dimensional coupled-mode calculations and two-dimensional particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations. Adding the extra branches increases temporal growth and spatial gain across the tested crossing angles. In three dimensions, direct branches alone give weak, localized side scatter; with the cross branches present, a strong field fills much of the interaction region even though the incident beams, direct channels and initial seed are unchanged. The distinction persists at fixed total power. The coupled response remains strong as the power per beam falls, whereas the direct-only response drops rapidly. PIC spectra contain nearby scattered-light features accompanied by several pump-specific IAW branches, and the fixed-power scans yield a strong, non-monotonic response. These results support cross-channel feedback through separate IAWs as a multibeam SBS amplification mechanism that may help predict and control SBS losses in laser-fusion plasmas.

AI.tldr: 多束受激布里渊散射（SBS）中，侧向散射波可分别通过不同的离子声波（IAW）支路从多个泵浦光获取能量；这些散射波虽处于近乎相同的波矢区域，但因频率不同而仍是不同的光模。论文结合局域增长模型、有限宽度增益模型、三维耦合模计算和二维PIC模拟，表明交叉支路能增强SBS增长与空间增益，并在固定总功率下维持较强的耦合响应，从而提出一种交叉通道反馈式的多束SBS放大机制。
AI.motivation: 研究多束SBS的放大机制：当一侧向散射波通过多条彼此独立的IAW支路从多个泵浦光中吸取能量时，该过程不属于寻常的“子波耦合”。作者希望理解不同泵浦产生的散射波在波矢区域接近但频率不同的情况下如何共同作用，并评估该机制对激光聚变等离子体中SBS损耗预测与控制的潜在意义。
AI.method: 采用局域增长模型和有限宽度增益模型、三维耦合模计算以及二维粒子-in-cell（PIC）模拟；考察不同交叉角，并进行固定总功率扫描，比较仅直接支路与包含交叉支路时的响应。摘要未提供具体角度、功率、等离子体参数或数值设置。
AI.result: 在所测试的交叉角范围内，加入额外支路可提高时间增长率和空间增益。三维计算中，仅有直接支路时侧向散射较弱且局域化；存在交叉支路时，在入射束、直接通道和初始种子均不变的条件下，强场可充满较大相互作用区域，且该差异在固定总功率下仍存在。随着每束功率降低，耦合响应仍较强，而仅直接支路的响应快速下降。PIC谱中出现邻近的散射光特征及多条与泵浦相关的IAW支路，固定功率扫描呈强且非单调的响应。摘要未给出定量数值。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过彼此独立的IAW实现交叉通道反馈，可作为一种多束SBS放大机制；该机制可能有助于预测和控制激光聚变等离子体中的SBS损耗。上述结论仅基于摘要，具体定量参数和适用范围未在摘要中提供。

title: A thermodynamically consistent, fully compressible, fluctuating hydrodynamics model of a Cahn Hilliard binary fluid mixture
summary: We derive, from first principles, a thermodynamically consistent set of fully compressible fluctuating hydrodynamic equations for a Cahn-Hilliard binary fluid mixture, in isothermal and non-isothermal form and for symmetric and non-symmetric mixtures. The derivation uses the GENERIC formalism, with the friction operator constructed from flux fluctuations following Jelic and Ottinger, so that deterministic and stochastic fluxes derive from the same operator and correlation matrix and the fluctuation-dissipation theorem holds by construction. We show that the momentum equation must use the total mass density, that the Cahn-Hilliard variable is the mass fraction, and that the diffusion flux must be driven by the specific, not the volumetric, exchange potential. We derive a generalized Korteweg tensor for square-gradient energies in density and composition, and show that the reversible pressure tensor of the non-isothermal model is fixed by the degeneracy condition, producing a thermal capillary stress when the interfacial free energy has an entropic part. Thermodynamic consistency is proved in full: Jacobi identity, positivity and degeneracy, local energy conservation with interstitial-working fluxes, a local entropy balance, Soret-Dufour reciprocity, and Einstein statistics of the linearized equations. The final equations are written in conservative form for finite-volume discretization, and closed-form static and dynamic structure factors are given for all models as analytic benchmarks. An appendix shows that the same models follow from classical irreversible thermodynamics with the Helmholtz or Gibbs free energy; this route is unique for isothermal flows and has a gauge freedom in the non-isothermal case that GENERIC removes.

AI.tldr: 本文从第一性原理和 GENERIC 形式出发，构建热力学一致的、完全可压缩的 Cahn-Hilliard 二元流体混合物的涨落流体动力学方程，覆盖等温/非等温及对称/非对称情形，并给出守恒形式、结构因子基准和经典不可逆热力学对照。
AI.motivation: 旨在为 Cahn-Hilliard 二元流体混合物建立热力学一致且完全可压缩的涨落流体动力学模型，使确定性通量与随机通量由同一摩擦算子导出、涨落耗散定理自动成立，并为有限体积离散和解析基准提供统一框架。
AI.method: 采用 GENERIC 形式，并仿照 Jelic 和 Ottinger 由通量涨落构造摩擦算子，使确定性和随机通量共享同一算子与相关矩阵；推导中确定动量方程使用总质量密度、Cahn-Hilliard 变量为质量分数、扩散通量由比交换势而非体积交换势驱动；推导密度与组分平方梯度能量的广义 Korteweg 张量；非等温模型的可逆压力张量由退化条件固定，并在界面自由能含熵部分时产生热毛细应力；证明 Jacobi 恒等式、正性与退化性、含间隙功通量的局部能量守恒、局部熵平衡、Soret-Dufour 互易性及线性化方程的 Einstein 统计；将方程写成便于有限体积离散的守恒形式，并给出闭式静态和动态结构因子；附录用 Helmholtz 或 Gibbs 自由能的经典不可逆热力学导出同一模型。
AI.result: 得到了等温/非等温、对称/非对称混合物的热力学一致完全可压缩涨落流体动力学方程；完整证明了热力学一致性；给出了适用于有限体积离散的守恒形式；为所有模型提供了闭式静态和动态结构因子作为解析基准；附录表明经典不可逆热力学可导出相同模型，该路径在等温流动中唯一，在非等温情形存在规范自由度而 GENERIC 可消除之。
AI.conclusion: GENERIC 框架为 Cahn-Hilliard 二元流体混合物提供了热力学一致、可压缩且含涨落的流体动力学描述，并消除了非等温经典不可逆热力学路径中的规范自由度；所得守恒方程和结构因子可用于有限体积离散与解析验证。摘要未提供数值实验或实验验证结果。

title: Generative AI models for exploring diffusion dynamics from multi-frame particle tracking
summary: Particle-based volumetric flow measurement techniques have proven their efficacy in quantitatively assessing the dynamic characteristics of unsteady flows within the realm of fluid mechanics. Despite recent advances in multi-frame particle tracking, an open challenge in this area is maintaining trajectories in temporally under-sampled 3D sequences, where inter-frame displacements are large. In this work, we develop DiffTR-Flow3D, a diffusion-based model that estimates flow motion from spatiotemporal three-dimensional particle recordings via a stochastic diffusion process. DiffTR-Flow3D conditions the diffusion process with both global and local particle dynamics and enhances flow estimation by leveraging historical particle trajectories. Extensive experiments, including numerical simulations and real-world measurements, demonstrate that DiffTR-Flow3D achieves state-of-the-art displacement estimation accuracy compared with learning-based flow estimators, and, when integrated into particle tracking pipelines, substantially improves their long-term tracking performance, while exhibiting robustness and generalization across diverse flow patterns. This work is expected to provide fluid researchers with an effective tool for the consistent and precise analysis of particle trajectories in temporally under-sampled 3D sequences with large inter-frame displacements.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于扩散模型的 DiffTR-Flow3D，用于从时空三维粒子记录中估计流场运动，以应对时间欠采样、帧间位移较大的 3D 序列中的轨迹保持难题；实验表明其位移估计精度达到先进水平，并能提升粒子跟踪流程的长期性能。
AI.motivation: 粒子基体积流测量对非定常流分析很重要，但现有多帧粒子跟踪方法仍难以在时间欠采样、帧间位移较大的三维序列中维持轨迹，这是待解决的开放挑战。
AI.method: 作者开发 DiffTR-Flow3D：一种基于扩散的模型，通过随机扩散过程从时空三维粒子记录估计流动运动；该模型以全局和局部粒子动力学为条件，并利用历史粒子轨迹增强流估计。
AI.result: 数值仿真和真实测量实验显示，与基于学习的流估计器相比，DiffTR-Flow3D 达到最先进的位移估计精度；将其集成到粒子跟踪流程后可显著改善长期跟踪性能，并在多种流型上表现出鲁棒性和泛化能力。摘要未提供具体误差指标或数据集细节。
AI.conclusion: 该工作有望为流体研究者提供有效工具，用于对时间欠采样且帧间位移较大的三维序列进行一致、精确的粒子轨迹分析。

title: Enabling Mie Resonances for Optomagnetism in Epitaxially Grown Garnet Nanodisks via Photonic Crystals
summary: An all-garnet photonic-crystal substrate compatible with epitaxial growth on gadolinium gallium garnet is proposed for controlling the optomagnetic response of a single bismuth iron garnet nanodisk. The photonic environment modifies the spectral positions and relative strengths of the electric- and magnetic-dipole contributions and redistributes the optical field inside the disk. Compared with a reference nanodisk on a homogeneous substrate evaluated near the broad maximum of its summed multipolar response, the peak axial optical contribution to the inverse Faraday effect in the examined cross-sections is enhanced by factors of approximately 7.3 and 6.3 in the magnetic- and electric-dipole-dominated regimes, respectively. The enhancement reaches approximately 7.9 at the maximum of the summed multipolar scattering contributions. These results demonstrate spectral control of the magnitude and spatial distribution of the local optomagnetic response through the photonic environment, without changing the nanodisk geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可与钆镓石榴石外延生长兼容的全石榴石光子晶体衬底，用于调控单个铋铁石榴石纳米盘的光磁响应；该光子环境改变电/磁偶极贡献的光谱位置与相对强度，并重新分布盘内光场，使逆法拉第效应的轴向光学贡献相对均匀衬底参考样品提高约6.3–7.9倍。
AI.motivation: 旨在在不改变铋铁石榴石纳米盘几何结构的前提下，通过可外延集成的全石榴石光子晶体衬底控制单个纳米盘的光磁响应，并增强逆法拉第效应相关的局部光学贡献。
AI.method: 设计并与钆镓石榴石外延兼容的全石榴石光子晶体衬底，将其与均匀衬底上的参考纳米盘进行比较；分析光子环境对电偶极和磁偶极贡献的光谱位置、相对强度及盘内光场分布的影响，并评估所考察截面中逆法拉第效应的峰值轴向光学贡献。
AI.result: 相对于均匀衬底参考纳米盘在总和多极响应宽峰附近的结果，磁偶极主导和电偶极主导区域的逆法拉第效应峰值轴向光学贡献分别增强约7.3倍和6.3倍；在总和多极散射贡献最大值处增强约7.9倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，仅通过光子环境即可光谱调控局部光磁响应的大小和空间分布，而无需改变纳米盘几何结构；摘要未提供实验制备或测量验证细节。

title: Multi-dimensional kinetic modeling of laser-plasma instabilities by a Vlasov-Maxwell system
summary: We present PLAW-EM2d (Two-Dimensional PLAsmaWave ElectroMagnetic Simulation), a two-dimensional Vlasov-Maxwell code for kinetic studies of laser-plasma interactions. The code combines a hybrid electrostatic- TEz field decomposition with an Eulerian 2d2v Vlasov solver for the electron distribution function and a cold closure for the out-of-plane response. Vacuum propagation, Landau damping, and a homogeneousplasma comparison with PIC simulations benchmark the coupled solver. We then consider two representative SRS problems. In an inhomogeneous plasma, the code reproduces convective SRS backscatter with a reflectivity consistent with the Rosenbluth estimate. In a transversely extended target, it captures SRS side scattering in a self-consistent two-dimensional Vlasov simulation, resolving oblique electromagnetic and Langmuir waves that satisfy the resonance conditions. These calculations show that PLAW-EM2d can describe both conventional SRS backscatter and a two-dimensional side-scattering channel relevant to laser-plasma interactions in ICF.

AI.tldr: 论文介绍并验证了二维 Vlasov-Maxwell 代码 PLAW-EM2d，并将其用于自洽模拟非均匀等离子体中的对流 SRS 背散射和横向扩展靶中的 SRS 侧散射。
AI.motivation: 开展激光-等离子体相互作用的动理学研究，特别是为惯性约束聚变（ICF）相关受激拉曼散射（SRS）提供能够自洽描述二维侧散射通道的 Vlasov 模拟工具；摘要未提供更广泛的背景动机。
AI.method: 开发 PLAW-EM2d 二维 Vlasov-Maxwell 代码，采用静电-TEz 混合场分解、电子分布函数的 Eulerian 2d2v Vlasov 求解器以及面外响应的冷闭包；通过真空传播、Landau 阻尼及与 PIC 模拟的均匀等离子体比较进行基准测试，并应用于非均匀等离子体背散射和横向扩展靶侧散射两个 SRS 问题。
AI.result: 基准测试表明耦合求解器可用于真空传播、Landau 阻尼和均匀等离子体比较；在非均匀等离子体中复现对流 SRS 背散射，反射率与 Rosenbluth 估计一致；在横向扩展靶中自洽捕获 SRS 侧散射，并分辨满足共振条件的斜向电磁波和 Langmuir 波。
AI.conclusion: PLAW-EM2d 能够描述常规 SRS 背散射以及与非均匀等离子体和 ICF 激光-等离子体相互作用相关的二维侧散射通道；摘要未给出定量计算参数或与实验的进一步比较。

title: Gradient-Aware AI Agents for Autonomous Turbulence Model Discovery via Differentiable CFD
summary: Turbulence modeling relies on human choices of closure form, physical inputs, and tunable parameters. Training closures a posteriori is efficient only with gradients through long chaotic rollouts, which few solvers provide. Most a posteriori approaches therefore resort to gradient-free optimization, and nearly all fix the closure form in advance, learning only its parameters. In this work, we introduce a gradient-aware agentic framework that poses closure discovery as a bilevel problem: a multi-agent large language model (LLM) system searches over closure forms, while a GPU-native differentiable computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solver supplies gradients, making differentiable a posteriori learning an action of the autonomous AI agent. For each proposal, the agents construct a differentiable training program by embedding the analytical, neural, or hybrid closure in the solver, implementing a differentiable objective, and validating the gradient path. They then decide whether to evaluate the closure, compute its parameter sensitivities, or train it a posteriori, select the optimization settings, and revise subsequent proposals using the simulation outcomes and returned gradients. Truncated-horizon gradients make this training usable under chaotic dynamics for closures with tens of thousands of parameters. Demonstrations include dissipation-law and subgrid-scale closure discovery in two-dimensional turbulence and wall-model discovery for large-eddy simulation of three-dimensional channel flow. With gradient-based training, the agent recovers reference coefficients that forward evaluation alone does not reach within the same budget, and autonomously discovers and trains analytical and neural closures that improve agreement with the targeted reference statistics. These results demonstrate the feasibility of end-to-end autonomous turbulence model development in time-resolved flows.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种具备梯度感知能力的多智能体LLM框架，将湍流闭合模型发现表述为双层问题：上层由LLM智能体搜索闭合形式，下层借助GPU原生可微分CFD求解器提供梯度，实现可微的后验学习，并在二维湍流和三维槽道LES中验证。
AI.motivation: 湍流建模依赖人工选择闭合形式、物理输入和可调参数；后验训练若要通过长时间混沌滚动传播梯度，只有少数求解器支持，因此多数后验方法只能采用无梯度优化，且几乎都预先固定闭合形式、仅学习参数。论文旨在让闭合形式搜索与后验训练借助梯度和LLM智能体实现自主化。
AI.method: 提出梯度感知的智能体框架，把闭合发现作为双层问题：多智能体LLM系统搜索闭合形式，GPU原生可微分CFD求解器提供梯度，并将可微后验学习作为自主AI智能体的动作。对每个提议，智能体将解析、神经网络或混合闭合嵌入求解器，构建可微训练程序，实现可微目标并验证梯度路径；随后决定评估闭合、计算参数敏感性或进行后验训练，选择优化设置，并依据模拟结果和返回梯度修正后续提议。截断时域梯度使该方法在混沌动力学下可训练含数万参数的闭合模型。
AI.result: 在二维湍流的耗散律与亚网格尺度闭合发现，以及三维槽道流大涡模拟的壁模型发现中进行了演示。采用基于梯度的训练时，智能体能够恢复参考系数，而仅靠前向评估在相同预算内无法达到；智能体还能自主发现并训练解析和神经闭合，使结果与目标参考统计量更一致。摘要未给出具体定量误差或加速比。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在时间解析流动中实现端到端自主湍流模型开发是可行的。

title: Three-body streaming forces lower the axial binding threshold of a held transverse three-sphere chain
summary: Particles in oscillatory liquids can form chains perpendicular to the drive. We ask whether the forces between isolated pairs predict when three spheres can bind at a finite spacing. We first hold the spheres fixed during small-amplitude oscillation and calculate the cycle-averaged force on an end sphere. The three-body contribution lowers the critical Stokes number from 4.283 for the pair-additive model to 3.534 for the full chain, a reduction of 17.5 percent. An independent finite-element calculation reproduces the shift. The three-body attraction also draws the spheres close enough for the nearest-neighbour pair forces to become repulsive. This compression accounts for most of the tendency to bend out of the plane containing the drive and the chain. For freely translating and rotating spheres at a particle-to-liquid density ratio of 2.2, the multipole calculation predicts initial growth of this bend at five sampled equilibria. A point-singularity calculation confirms the sign at two of those spacings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究振荡液体中三个球体能否在有限间距下结合，并检验双体配对力是否足以预测该行为；结果表明三体作用显著降低临界Stokes数，并主导面外弯曲趋势。
AI.motivation: 作者要回答：孤立球对之间的力能否预测三个球体何时能在有限间距下结合。
AI.method: 先在小振幅振荡中固定球体，计算端球的周期平均力，并比较配对叠加模型与完整三球链；用独立有限元计算复核。随后对可自由平动和转动、颗粒与液体密度比为2.2的球体采用多极计算，并在五个采样平衡间距考察弯曲；另用点奇异性计算进行符号验证。
AI.result: 三体贡献将临界Stokes数从配对叠加模型的4.283降至完整链的3.534，降幅17.5%；独立有限元计算复现该偏移。三体吸引使球体靠近到最近邻配对力变为排斥，这种压缩解释了大部分偏离由驱动方向和链所构成平面的趋势。对密度比2.2的自由球体，多极计算预测该面外弯曲在五个采样平衡间距处初始增长；点奇异性计算在其中两个间距确认了符号。
AI.conclusion: 双体配对力不足以完整预测三球有限间距结合；三体作用会降低结合阈值，并通过压缩诱导最近邻排斥，从而显著促进链的面外弯曲。实验验证等细节未在摘要中提供。

title: Chiral high harmonic generation via coherent superposition of multi-channel interband transitions
summary: Circularly polarized light, with its specific handedness, is a valuable tool for investigating the chirality related properties of materials, including their structural, electronic, magnetic and topological characteristics. This has led to efforts in creating wavelength-tunable coherent light with circular or elliptical polarization through a sub-cycle ultrafast process high-harmonic generation (HHG). Existing approaches to chiral HHG, however, typically rely on multidimensional driving fields, materials engineering or complex optical architectures. Here we uncover a distinct mechanism without such complexity, where a single linearly polarized driving field generates chiral HHG from a pristine crystal. We show that, in the Weyl semimetal NbP, one linearly polarized near-infrared driving field generates high harmonics with pronounced ellipticity. Semi-conductor Bloch equations (SBEs) reveal that this ellipticity originates from the coherent superposition of multiple interband transitions, each contributing harmonics with distinct linear polarizations and relative phases. We further substantiate this mechanism by shifting the driving photon energy into the mid-infrared, which strongly suppresses the ellipticity as the number of accessible interband transition channels is reduced. These results establish a simple and general mechanism for chiral HHG, and show that quantum materials can transform an apparently achiral driving field into polarization-tunable ultrafast chiral emission.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了一种无需多维驱动场、材料工程或复杂光路架构的手性高次谐波产生机制：在纯净的Weyl半金属NbP中，单一线偏振近红外驱动场即可产生具有显著椭圆率的高次谐波；半导体Bloch方程表明该椭圆率源于多个带间跃迁的相干叠加，并通过将驱动光子能量移至中红外、减少可及带间跃迁通道来验证该机制。
AI.motivation: 圆偏振光可用于研究材料的结构、电子、磁性和拓扑等手性相关性质，因此人们希望利用亚周期超快高次谐波产生获得波长可调的圆偏振或椭圆偏振相干光；但现有手性HHG方案通常依赖多维驱动场、材料工程或复杂光学架构，亟需更简单的机制。
AI.method: 采用单一线偏振近红外驱动场照射纯净Weyl半金属NbP，产生高次谐波并分析其偏振特性；利用半导体Bloch方程（SBEs）研究谐波椭圆率的微观来源；进一步将驱动光子能量移至中红外，通过减少可及的带间跃迁通道来检验所提出的机制。
AI.result: 在NbP中，单一线偏振近红外驱动场产生的高次谐波具有显著椭圆率。SBEs揭示该椭圆率来自多个带间跃迁的相干叠加，各跃迁贡献具有不同线偏振和相对相位的高次谐波。将驱动光子能量移至中红外后，可及带间跃迁通道数减少，椭圆率被强烈抑制，从而支持该机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一种简单且通用的手性HHG机制，并表明量子材料可将表观非手性的驱动场转化为偏振可调的 ultrafast 手性发射；摘要未提供谐波转换效率、具体实验条件或波长调谐范围等细节。

title: Data-driven non-contiguous photon-energy groups for fast multigroup radiation transport in line-dominated plasmas
summary: Opacity of mid- and high-$Z$ plasmas is dominated by thousands of overlapping spectral lines. Examples are laser-produced plasmas for extreme-ultraviolet (EUV) lithography, inertial-fusion hohlraums, and stellar interiors. Radiation transport in such plasmas needs more than 1000 photon-energy groups in the EUV case, and this makes radiation-hydrodynamic simulations very expensive. We show that the accuracy of a small-group opacity model can be recovered by choosing properly \emph{which} fine bins are put into the same group. We present a data-driven method that assigns the fine bins of a detailed opacity and emissivity table to $K$ \emph{non-contiguous} groups. Each group has a fixed spectral shape inside it. The groups follow from one requirement: the reduced absorption operator must be diagonal for every plasma state. They are determined from a Gram matrix of spectra, taken from detailed-group solutions of a small part, for example 5\% in this work, of the parameter space. The reduced model is a set of $K$ uncoupled flux-limited diffusion equations. It can be used in an existing multigroup code by replacing the opacity table. For a Sn plasma with electron densities of $4\times10^{15}$--$1.1\times10^{21}$~cm$^{-3}$, electron temperatures of 5--250~eV, and scale lengths of 2.5--6900$\um$, the model with $K=100$ reproduces the total flux of the 1500-group reference with a median error of 2\% and a 90th-percentile error of 8\%. The 90th-percentile error is ten times smaller than that of a conventional 100-group model at the same cost.

AI.tldr: 提出一种数据驱动的非连续分群不透明度模型：把详细表的精细能组归并为K个非连续群，并要求约化吸收算符在各等离子体态下均为对角；在Sn等离子体上K=100相对1500群参考的总通量中位误差2%、90分位误差8%，同成本下优于常规100群模型约10倍。
AI.motivation: 中高Z等离子体不透明度由数千条重叠谱线主导，EUV光刻、惯性约束聚变相关腔体和恒星内部等场景的辐射输运可能需要超过1000个光子能量群，使辐射流体力学模拟非常昂贵；因此需要低群数但保持精度的小群不透明度模型。
AI.method: 提出数据驱动方法，将详细不透明度与发射率表的精细能组分配给K个非连续群，每个群内部采用固定谱形；分群依据是约化吸收算符对每个等离子体态都必须为对角。群由光谱Gram矩阵确定，光谱取自参数空间一小部分（本文为5%）的详细群解。约化模型由K个解耦的通量限制扩散方程组成，可通过替换不透明度表用于现有多群代码。
AI.result: 对电子密度4×10^15–1.1×10^21 cm^-3、电子温度5–250 eV、尺度长度2.5–6900 µm的Sn等离子体，K=100模型相对1500群参考的总通量中位误差为2%，90分位误差为8%；其90分位误差比同成本常规100群模型小10倍。
AI.conclusion: 合理选择哪些精细能组归入同一非连续群，可恢复小群不透明度模型的精度，并在相同成本下显著优于常规分群，从而降低辐射流体力学模拟成本；摘要未提供具体加速比、其他物理量误差以及Sn以外体系的验证。

title: Efficient refractive-index sweeps in the discrete dipole approximation using shifted Krylov methods
summary: The discrete dipole approximation (DDA) is a flexible numerical method for simulating electromagnetic scattering by particles of arbitrary shape and internal structure. In many applications, such as optical-database generation, the same particle geometry must be simulated for many values of the complex refractive index, which are currently handled independently with proportional increase of computational time. For homogeneous particles, however, variations of the refractive index affect only the diagonal polarizability term of the interaction matrix. The corresponding linear systems therefore differ only by scalar shifts of the identity matrix, making them suitable for shifted Krylov-subspace methods. In this work, we use a shifted Krylov solver adapted to the complex-symmetric formulation of the matrix and implement it in the ADDA code. The method is evaluated for a homogeneous spherical particle over a two-dimensional domain of complex refractive indices. The shifted solver reproduces the extinction cross sections obtained from independent simulations with relative differences below the iterative-method tolerance, while reducing the number of matrix-vector products by a factor of 130 for the tested configuration. We further analyze how the achievable speedup depends on the number of refractive-index values, the computational backend, and the variation of the convergence rate across the parameter space. The final wall-time acceleration for large refractive-index sweeps was demonstrated to be up to 40 times, which can be further improved by optimizing the scattered-fields calculations that became a new bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文将适用于复对称矩阵的移位 Krylov 子空间求解器集成到 ADDA 中，用于加速 DDA 在大量复折射率取值下的重复电磁散射仿真；测试中矩阵-向量乘法减少约 130 倍，大规模折射率扫描的墙钟时间加速最高约 40 倍，并指出散射场计算成为新瓶颈。
AI.motivation: DDA 常用于模拟任意形状和内部结构粒子的电磁散射，但在光学数据库生成等应用中，同一粒子几何需对许多复折射率值重复仿真，现有做法独立求解，计算时间随折射率数量近似成正比增加。对于均匀粒子，折射率变化仅影响相互作用矩阵的对角极化率项，因此对应线性系统仅相差单位矩阵的标量移位，适合采用移位 Krylov 子空间方法复用计算。
AI.method: 作者针对 DDA 相互作用矩阵的复对称形式采用移位 Krylov 求解器，并将其实现于 ADDA 代码中；利用均匀粒子中折射率变化仅改变对角极化率项、线性系统仅相差单位矩阵标量移位的性质。以一个均匀球形粒子在二维复折射率参数域上进行评估，并分析可达加速比与折射率取值数量、计算后端以及参数空间中收敛率变化的关系。摘要未给出具体的粒子尺寸、折射率范围和后端细节。
AI.result: 移位求解器得到的消光截面与独立仿真结果一致，相对差异低于迭代方法容差；在测试配置中，矩阵-向量乘法次数减少约 130 倍。对于大规模折射率扫描，最终墙钟时间加速最高达到约 40 倍；进一步加速受限于散射场计算，其已成为新的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 移位 Krylov 方法能够有效复用均匀粒子在不同复折射率下的 DDA 计算，在保持结果精度的同时显著减少矩阵-向量乘法和大规模扫描的计算时间；若进一步优化已成为新瓶颈的散射场计算，加速效果还可提升。

title: Data-driven Correction Reduced-Order Stochastic Collocation Method for the Time-Dependent Navier-Stokes Equations
summary:
We develop two hybrid data-driven Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) Reduced-Order Models (ROMs) for the non-stationary incompressible Navier--Stokes Equations (NSEs) with random viscosity. The proposed framework combines Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) ROMs, spatial filtering, data-driven closure modeling, and the Stochastic Collocation Method (SCM). A key feature is the approximation of the realization-dependent closure term by the closure associated with the expected viscosity. Consequently, a single data-driven closure model constructed from the full-order solution corresponding to the expected viscosity can be reused across all realizations, thereby avoiding the expensive construction of realization-specific closure models. This leads to the Data-Driven Correction UQ ROM (DDC-UQ-ROM) and its physically constrained variant, the Constrained DDC-UQ-ROM (CDDC-UQ-ROM), in which physical constraints are imposed on the data-driven correction model.
  The proposed methods are evaluated for a two-dimensional (2D) flow past a circular cylinder problem with a 5D random viscosity field, considering mean Reynolds numbers $Re=100$ and $Re=500$, different correlation lengths, and both in-sample and out-of-sample parameter settings. Numerical results show that the DDC-UQ-ROM generally improves upon the standard Galerkin ROM (G-ROM), while the CDDC-UQ-ROM exhibits the most accurate and robust approximation of the benchmark energy evolution across the cases considered. The robustness and accuracy of the CDDC-UQ-ROM are further assessed through statistical error analyses of the first- and second-order energy moments, reduced-training-data experiments, and an indicative comparison of wall-clock computational costs with the full-order UQ calculations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出两种混合数据驱动的不确定性量化降阶模型，用于随机黏度非定常不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程：DDC-UQ-ROM及带物理约束的CDDC-UQ-ROM，结合POD、空间滤波、数据驱动闭包和随机配点法，并用期望黏度对应的单一闭包模型复用于所有实现。
AI.motivation: 针对随机黏度非定常不可压缩NSE的不确定性量化，需要高效且准确的降阶建模；关键动机是避免为每个随机实现分别构建昂贵的数据驱动闭包模型，通过期望黏度对应的闭包近似实现相关闭包项，从而复用单一闭包模型。摘要未进一步给出其他应用动机。
AI.method: 方法框架结合POD降阶模型、空间滤波、数据驱动闭包建模和随机配点法SCM；用期望黏度对应的闭包近似依赖于实现的闭包项，使由期望黏度全阶解构建的单一数据驱动闭包模型可跨所有实现复用。由此形成DDC-UQ-ROM，以及在其数据驱动修正模型上施加物理约束的CDDC-UQ-ROM。
AI.result: 在二维圆柱绕流问题上评估，采用5维随机黏度场，考察Re=100和Re=500、不同相关长度以及样本内和样本外参数设置。数值结果表明DDC-UQ-ROM通常优于标准Galerkin ROM，CDDC-UQ-ROM在所考虑案例中对基准能量演化的逼近最准确、最稳健；还通过一阶和二阶能量矩的统计误差分析、减少训练数据实验以及与全阶UQ计算的墙钟时间指示性比较评估了CDDC-UQ-ROM的稳健性和精度。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，以期望黏度闭包复用于各随机实现的方式可构建有效的UQ降阶模型；CDDC-UQ-ROM因引入物理约束而表现出最佳精度和稳健性。摘要未提供具体加速比或定量误差数值。

title: Optical fiber shape sensing using picosecond spatiotemporal single-photon reflectometry
comment: Main draft: 24 pages, 8 figures. Supplementary information: 13 pages, 8 figures
summary: Inferring the three-dimensional configuration of a flexible optical fiber from a single accessible end remains a fundamental challenge in photonic sensing. Existing approaches typically require specialised multicore fibers, coherent interferometry, or distributed spectral encoding. Here, we demonstrate a fundamentally different sensing paradigm in which fiber geometry is reconstructed from the spatiotemporal dynamics of returning single photons. Using a laser-engineered multimode fiber interrogated by a time-resolved 32x32 single-photon avalanche diode array, we show that fiber deformation imprints unique signatures onto the distribution and arrival time of back-reflected photons. We map these high-dimensional photon-return states onto a low-dimensional geometric manifold, enabling continuous bend-angle estimation and reconstruction of previously unseen two- and three-dimensional shapes from measurements acquired entirely at the proximal fiber end. Measurements show a median pixel-wise signal-to-noise ratio of approximately 26 dB and below 1% repeatability variation. Our results establish multimode single-photon dynamics as an information-rich channel for distributed geometric sensing, introducing a new framework for single-ended fiber shape reconstruction and minimally invasive photonic navigation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种基于单端背反射单光子时空动力学的光纤几何传感新范式：利用激光加工多模光纤和时间分辨32×32单光子雪崩二极管阵列，从光子返回分布与到达时间重建此前未见的二维和三维光纤形状。
AI.motivation: 从单一可及端推断柔性光纤的三维构型仍是光子传感中的基础难题；现有方法通常依赖专用多芯光纤、相干干涉或分布式光谱编码，本文旨在探索一种根本不同的单端形状重建途径。
AI.method: 采用激光加工的多模光纤，并由时间分辨32×32单光子雪崩二极管阵列进行探测；光纤形变会在背反射光子的分布和到达时间上留下独特特征。作者将高维光子返回状态映射到低维几何流形，从而实现连续弯曲角度估计，并仅利用近端测量重建此前未见的二维和三维形状。
AI.result: 测量显示中位逐像素信噪比约为26 dB，重复性变化低于1%；并实现了连续弯曲角度估计以及此前未见的二维和三维形状重建。文中未提供更具体的形状重建误差或空间分辨率指标。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了多模单光子动力学作为分布式几何传感的信息丰富通道，为单端光纤形状重建和微创光子导航提供了新框架。

title: Effect of Gas Pressure and Molecular Structure in the Spatial-Mode Conversion of Terahertz Radiation from a Plasma Filament
summary: In this work, the generation of terahertz (THz) radiation under single color filamentation of a femtosecond laser pulse in an optical cell with compressed gases (argon, nitrogen, CO2) in broad pressure range from 0.001 to 25 atm is experimentally studied for the first time. A nonmonotonic dependence of the integral energy of the THz signal on the gas pressure is revealed, which can be attributed to the competition between an increase in the plasma density and the development of plasma selfabsorption processes, multiple filamentation of the femtosecond pump, and collision induced absorption in the neutral medium. We show that the molecular structure of the gas critically determines the pressure optimum of generation, shifting the maximum of the THz energy yield to the region of elevated pressures (from 10 to 15 atm) for monatomic argon and to the region of subatmospheric pressures (approx. 0.1 atm) for molecular carbon dioxide due to strong vibrational rotational dissipation. On the basis of numerical 3D modeling, it is shown that the cylindrical metal waveguide insert used for signal collection operates in a strongly multimode regime and substantially transforms the angular spectrum of the THz source. We demonstrate that the conical structure of the THz radiation recorded in the experiment is a consequence of intermode interference and diffraction at the output end face of the waveguide, which transforms the true parameters of THz generation in the plasma channel.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在0.001–25 atm宽压强范围内，实验研究飞秒激光单色丝化在压缩气体（氩、氮、CO2）中产生太赫兹辐射，并结合三维数值建模分析压强依赖性和金属波导对太赫兹角谱的畸变。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对宽压强范围内单色丝化产生太赫兹的规律认识不足，尤其需要明确气体压强、气体分子结构以及信号收集波导对太赫兹产生参数的影响。
AI.method: 在含压缩氩、氮和CO2的光学池中，以飞秒激光单色丝化产生太赫兹辐射，并在0.001–25 atm压强范围内测量太赫兹信号积分能量；同时采用三维数值建模分析圆柱形金属波导插入件及输出端面的传输效应。
AI.result: 太赫兹信号积分能量随气压呈非单调依赖，可归因于等离子体密度增加与等离子体自吸收、飞秒泵浦多丝化及中性介质碰撞诱导吸收之间的竞争。气体分子结构显著决定最佳压强：单原子氩的最佳区域为10–15 atm，分子CO2因强振动-转动耗散移至约0.1 atm的亚大气压区域。圆柱形金属波导插入件处于强多模 regime，显著改变太赫兹源的角谱；实验中记录的锥形太赫兹辐射源于模式间干涉和波导输出端面的衍射。
AI.conclusion: 气体分子结构是决定太赫兹产生最佳压强位置的关键因素；用于收集信号的金属波导会显著变换太赫兹角谱，使实验观测的锥形结构不能直接代表等离子体通道内真实的太赫兹产生参数。

title: CCGeant4: charge-state-resolved transport and energy-loss fluctuations of relativistic heavy ions in Geant4
summary: CCGeant4 models energy-loss fluctuations of heavy ions in Geant4, accounting for both charge exchange and relativistic corrections to electron scattering beyond the first Born approximation. We use GLOBAL cross sections for electron capture and loss, ATIMA equilibrium stopping powers and charge-dependent delta-electron spectra calculated from the Dirac equation in a frozen-shell potential. The package also supports tabulated elastic ion-nucleus scattering. The silicon example includes interference between Coulomb and nuclear scattering amplitudes. We compare charge evolution with GLOBAL and energy-loss spectra with MOCADI for matched beams and targets. Experimental comparisons cover the energy-loss measurements of Weick et al. and several measurements of energy deposited by xenon ions in silicon. For uranium at 800 MeV/u, the energy-loss variances from our Dirac configuration agree with the screened-ion calculations of Weick et al. to within 4% in Be, Al and Pb. Both calculations lie within the reported experimental uncertainties for all three targets, while calculated bismuth spectra in silver are narrower than measured. Calculations in thin silicon layers show that delta-electron escape can make deposited-energy distributions substantially narrower than primary-ion energy-loss distributions, highlighting the importance of secondary-electron transport for detector-response modelling. The distribution includes the Geant4 source patch, the transport tables and their converters, and a runnable example.

AI.tldr: CCGeant4 是一个集成于 Geant4 的重离子能损涨落建模工具，包含电荷交换、超出第一玻恩近似的相对论电子散射修正、GLOBAL 电子俘获/损失截面、ATIMA 平衡阻止本领、基于狄拉克方程与冻结壳层势的电荷相关 δ 电子谱，以及表格化弹性离子-核散射；研究将其与 GLOBAL、MOCADI 及多项实验数据比较，并给出硅中 δ 电子逃逸影响探测器响应的示例。
AI.motivation: 摘要未单独明确说明研究动机；从其内容可归纳为：在 Geant4 中更完整地描述重离子能损涨落，纳入电荷交换与相对论修正，并评估次级电子输运对沉积能量分布及探测器响应建模的重要性。
AI.method: 开发 CCGeant4 并集成到 Geant4；采用 GLOBAL 截面处理电子俘获与损失，采用 ATIMA 平衡阻止本领，采用由狄拉克方程在冻结壳层势中计算的电荷相关 δ 电子谱；支持表格化弹性离子-核散射；硅示例包含库仑与核散射振幅干涉；将电荷演化与 GLOBAL 比较、能损谱与 MOCADI 比较，并与 Weick 等等的能损测量及氙离子在硅中沉积能量的多项测量比较。
AI.result: 对 800 MeV/u 铀，狄拉克配置得到的能损方差与 Weick 等等的屏蔽离子计算在 Be、Al、Pb 中一致到 4% 以内；两种计算均处于三个靶的已报道实验不确定度内，但银中铋的计算谱比测量谱窄。薄硅层计算显示 δ 电子逃逸可使沉积能量分布明显窄于原初离子能损分布。
AI.conclusion: CCGeant4 能用于重离子能损涨落和电荷演化的建模与实验对比；结果表明次级电子输运对探测器响应建模很重要。作者还提供 Geant4 源码补丁、输运表及其转换器和可运行示例。部分实验比较存在差异，如银中铋谱计算值偏窄；摘要未给出更详细的物理解释。

title: Flow Structure in Idealized Rotating Detonation Combustor with Supersonic Inflow
summary: The work presented investigates the flow structure and stability of an airbreathing rotating detonation engine (RDE) in an idealized combustor. The presented derivation of a modified pressure cutoff injection scheme allows for supersonic injection in an idealized two-dimensional RDE as a function of a specified design Mach number and the pressure ratio across the injection surface. Numerical simulations are conducted using a compressible reacting flow solver with finite-rate chemistry built on an Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) framework. The fuel mixture is set to a stoichiometric hydrogen-air mixture for all simulations. Stable operation occurs for a wide range of inflow conditions with inflow Mach numbers up to 4. The increased total temperature associated with increasing Mach numbers causes burning at the injection surface during the injector recovery process, resulting in unstable operation. Meanwhile, increasing total pressure facilitates sustained supersonic injection. Analysis of the steady flow structure shows a familiar structure with significant changes to the detonation structure when compared with a rocket RDE. With supersonic inflow, an oblique detonation wave (ODW) forms along the injection surface connected to the moving detonation through a slip line. Changes in the oblique detonation wave and normal detonation angle occur with changes in the inflow Mach number, however the overall detonation structure remains similar when supersonic injection occurs.

AI.tldr: 研究理想化二维空呼吸旋转爆震发动机中改进压力截止喷射方案下的超音速喷射、流动结构与稳定性；稳定运行可达来流马赫数4，但总温升高会在喷射面引发燃烧并导致不稳定，流场中出现经滑移线与运动爆震相连的斜爆震波。
AI.motivation: 旨在理解空呼吸旋转爆震发动机在理想化燃烧室中的流动结构和稳定性，并考察以设计马赫数和喷射面压比为函数的超音速喷射可行性。
AI.method: 推导改进的压力截止喷射方案，使理想化二维旋转爆震发动机可按指定设计马赫数和喷射面压比实现超音速喷射；采用基于自适应网格加密（AMR）和有限速率化学的可压缩反应流求解器进行数值模拟，所有算例均为化学计量比氢-空气混合物。
AI.result: 在广泛的来流条件下可实现稳定运行，来流马赫数最高达4；来流马赫数提高带来的总温升高会在喷射器恢复过程中引起喷射面燃烧并导致不稳定，而提高总压有利于维持超音速喷射。稳态流场结构与火箭旋转爆震发动机相似，但爆震结构显著不同：超音速来流时喷射面形成斜爆震波，并通过滑移线与运动爆震相连；斜爆震波和正爆震角随来流马赫数变化，但只要发生超音速喷射，整体爆震结构仍保持相似。
AI.conclusion: 改进压力截止方案可用于理想化二维空呼吸旋转爆震发动机的超音速喷射研究；稳定性受总温与总压影响，超音速喷射下形成由斜爆震波、滑移线和运动爆震组成的流场结构。摘要未提供具体推力或效率等性能数据、实验验证及详细燃烧室几何参数。

title: Phonon-mediated visible upconversion luminescence in femtosecond 1030-nm pumped Tm3+ -doped silica fibres
summary: We investigate multiphoton absorption-driven visible luminescence in a thulium-doped aluminosilicate optical fiber excited by an ultrafast 1030-nm femtosecond pulse train in the {MHz domain}. We report the observation of an unusual spectral crossover: the predominance of an emission band centered at 457-nm (deep blue) is progressively overtaken by a second emission, centered at 475-nm (cyan), as launched average power increases. Concurrently, a third near-infrared emission around 792~nm exhibits persistent, monotonic growth characterized by a well-defined bilinear slope transition. By combining calibrated spectral band integration with a structure-informed rate-equation model based on host thermodynamics, we show that the visible spectra evolution is governed by non-radiative multi-phonon transfer and phonon-assisted cross-relaxation activated by cumulative core heating, rather than permanent color-center solarization. These results offer new predictive insights into the thermal and spectroscopic stability of high-power ultrafast fiber systems.

AI.tldr: 该文研究MHz域1030 nm飞秒脉冲序列激发下掺铥铝硅酸盐光纤中的多光子吸收驱动可见发光，观察到457 nm深蓝发射随平均功率增加被475 nm青色发射逐步取代，同时792 nm近红外发射呈双线性斜率转变的持续增长；作者用校准光谱积分与基于基质热力学的速率方程模型表明，该演化由累积纤芯加热激活的非辐射多声子转移和声子辅助交叉弛豫主导，而非永久性色心太阳化。
AI.motivation: 理解高功率超快光纤系统中掺铥铝硅酸盐光纤在多光子激发下的发光演化机制，并为其热学与光谱稳定性提供预测性认识。
AI.method: 采用1030 nm飞秒脉冲序列在MHz域激发掺铥铝硅酸盐光纤，测量多光子吸收驱动的可见及近红外发光；结合校准的光谱带积分和基于基质热力学的结构知情速率方程模型分析光谱演化机制。
AI.result: 观察到异常光谱交叉：随入射平均功率增加，457 nm深蓝发射带的主导地位逐渐被475 nm青色发射带取代；同时约792 nm近红外发射持续单调增强，并表现出明确的双线性斜率转变。摘要未提供具体功率阈值、发光效率或定量拟合参数。
AI.conclusion: 可见光谱演化主要由累积纤芯加热激活的非辐射多声子转移和声子辅助交叉弛豫控制，而非永久性色心太阳化；该结果可为高功率超快光纤系统的热与光谱稳定性提供新的预测性见解。

title: A deterministic theory of kinetic fluctuations in long-range interacting homogeneous systems without collective effects
summary: Finite-$N$ fluctuations govern the slow relaxation of long-range interacting systems, yet accessing their full statistics demands huge ensembles of costly simulations. We show that, in homogeneous systems without collective effects, this statistical problem collapses onto just three deterministic kinetic equations. Starting from the Landau-Dean-Kawasaki equation, i.e. the stochastic counterpart of the large deviation principle for the Landau equation, we derive the infinite hierarchy of $n$-point moments of the empirical distribution function at leading order in $1/N$. We prove that it is solved exactly by a quasi-Gaussian closure. The resulting minimal Landau fluctuation hierarchy is formed by the Landau equation, a Lyapunov equation for the two-point moment, and a kinetic equation for the three-point moment. From these three equations, all higher-order moments follow algebraically. The hierarchy exactly preserves the collisional invariants and their fluctuations, and predicts the full probability distribution of observables in the central fluctuation regime. Benchmarked against $N$-body realizations, it reproduces the mean, variance and higher-order moments with an accuracy that improves systematically with $N$. A single deterministic time-integration of three coupled partial differential equations thus replaces large ensembles of simulations, for any large $N$.

AI.tldr: 针对长程相互作用系统中由有限 N 涨落主导的慢弛豫，论文提出一个由三个确定性动理学方程构成的最小层级，用单次确定性时间积分替代大规模 N 体模拟系综，从而获得中心涨落区的可观测量分布及低阶矩。
AI.motivation: 有限 N 涨落决定长程相互作用系统的慢弛豫，但获取其完整统计需要大量昂贵模拟；论文旨在把均匀且无集体效应系统中的这一统计问题约化为少量确定性方程。
AI.method: 从 Landau-Dean-Kawasaki 方程（Landau 方程大偏差原理的随机对应）出发，在 1/N 领头阶推导经验分布函数 n 点矩的无限层级，并证明其可由准高斯闭合精确求解；由此得到最小 Landau 涨落层级，包括 Landau 方程、二点矩的 Lyapunov 方程和三点矩的动理学方程，更高阶矩由这三者代数给出。
AI.result: 该层级精确保持碰撞不变量及其涨落，并预测中心涨落区可观测量的完整概率分布；与 N 体实现进行基准比较时，可重现均值、方差和更高阶矩，且精度随 N 系统性提高。摘要未给出具体误差数值、测试系统或 N 的取值。
AI.conclusion: 在所述均匀、无集体效应且大 N 条件下，三个耦合偏微分方程的单次确定性时间积分可替代大规模模拟系综；摘要未讨论该约化在非均匀、集体效应显著或非中心涨落区间的适用性。

title: Analytic T-Matrix Formalism for Helmholtz Resonators
summary: We develop an analytic T-matrix formalism for two-dimensional circular acoustic Helmholtz resonators with thin rigid walls. The central idea is to use an aperture projection operator to obtain a compact expression for the T-matrix with explicit coefficients describing coupling and decoupling between external fields and cavity resonances. An equivalent formulation providing much faster convergence uses an aperture-to-Fourier map and an edge-adapted basis for the aperture flux. The method extends directly to multiple apertures of arbitrary angular widths and positions. The calculated scattering spectra agree with full-wave numerical simulations. For single- and double-aperture resonators, we decompose the T-matrix into even and odd parts under inversion to identify the channels associated with Willis coupling. We show how internal losses enable direction-dependent scattering and absorption when inversion symmetry is broken, while reciprocity ensures equal extinction for opposite incidence. Finally, we show how shifting the expansion origin redistributes radiation among multipole channels, enabling more compact T-matrix representations.

AI.tldr: 本文建立二维圆形声学亥姆霍兹共振器（薄刚性壁）的解析T矩阵形式，利用孔径投影算符及快速收敛的孔径到傅里叶映射/边缘适配基，计算单/双孔径及多孔径散射，分解T矩阵以识别Willis耦合通道，并分析内损耗、互易性及展开原点移动对散射、吸收和多极辐射的影响。
AI.motivation: 摘要未单独给出研究动机；其目标是建立可解析描述外部场与腔共振耦合/解耦的紧凑T矩阵形式，并推广到任意角宽和位置的多孔径，同时用于识别Willis耦合通道、理解内损耗下的方向相关散射与吸收，以及通过移动展开原点获得更紧凑的多极T矩阵表示。
AI.method: 采用孔径投影算符推导具有显式耦合/解耦系数的紧凑T矩阵；给出基于孔径到傅里叶映射和孔径通量边缘适配基的等效快速收敛形式；方法可直接扩展到多个任意角宽和位置的孔径；对单、双孔径共振器将T矩阵按反演对称性分解为偶部和奇部以识别Willis耦合通道；并研究移动展开原点对多极通道辐射分配的影响。
AI.result: 计算的散射谱与全波数值模拟一致；单、双孔径情形下通过偶/奇分解识别了与Willis耦合相关的通道；表明在反演对称性破缺时内损耗可实现方向相关的散射和吸收，而互易性保证相反入射方向具有相同消光；移动展开原点可重新分配多极通道间的辐射，从而获得更紧凑的T矩阵表示。
AI.conclusion: 该解析T矩阵框架能有效描述二维圆形亥姆霍兹共振器的散射，具有显式耦合系数、快速收敛和直接推广到多孔径的优点，并为Willis耦合、内损耗导致的方向相关散射/吸收及多极表示紧凑化提供分析工具；摘要未提供定量误差、适用参数范围或具体材料/几何数据。

title: Thermal convection and jets produced by human exhalation dominate the indoor spreading of emitted CO$_2$ and aerosols
comment: 22 pages (main text 9 pages + Supplementary Information 13 pages), 14 figures, 4 tables
summary: For understanding airborne viral infection pathways, the prediction of the spreading and effective diffusivity of saliva droplets emitted from a person while speaking and breathing is crucial. In non-ventilated indoor spaces, the spreading of tracer particles or molecules emitted by a person is governed by the complex interplay of molecular diffusion, convection due to body heat and temperature boundary conditions as well as propulsion due to breathing in and out. By comparison of grid-based simulations of the compressible Navier-Stokes equation with experiments measuring the spreading of CO$_2$ emitted from a person, we demonstrate that molecular diffusion of CO$_2$ is present, but that the long-distance CO$_2$ spreading is completely dominated by the combination of convection due to body heat and temperature gradients at walls and windows and the periodic breathing pattern of a person. Breathing out induces long-range advection by a mid-Reynolds number flow pattern akin to the Landau-Squire jet, while breathing in creates only short-range flow. In conjunction with thermal convection, this symmetry breaking between breathing in and out produces fast long-distance transport of CO$_2$ and small aerosols.

AI.tldr: 该文通过可压缩Navier–Stokes方程模拟与人体呼出CO2扩散实验对比，研究非通风室内示踪物传播机制，发现CO2长距离扩散主要不由分子扩散控制，而由人体热对流、壁面/窗户温度梯度及周期性呼吸共同主导。
AI.motivation: 理解空气传播病毒感染途径需要预测说话和呼吸时唾液液滴的传播及有效扩散率；在非通风室内，示踪粒子或分子的传播受分子扩散、人体热量与温度边界条件引起的对流以及呼吸进出的推进作用共同影响。
AI.method: 采用基于网格的可压缩Navier–Stokes方程模拟，并与测量人体呼出CO2传播的实验进行对比，以分析CO2传播中的分子扩散、热对流和周期性呼吸流动的作用。
AI.result: 研究表明CO2分子扩散存在，但长距离CO2传播完全由人体热量和壁面/窗户温度梯度引起的对流与人体周期性呼吸模式共同主导；呼气通过中等雷诺数下类似Landau–Squire射流的流型诱导长程平流，吸气仅产生短程流动；这种吸呼不对称性与热对流结合，产生CO2和小气溶胶的快速长距离输运。
AI.conclusion: 长距离示踪物传播主要由热对流和呼吸周期性流动的耦合控制，而非单纯分子扩散；摘要未提供有效扩散率的定量数值，也未给出具体的感染风险或实际通风干预结论。

title: PISim: A Unified Photonic Inference Simulator for Hardware-Aware Cross-Layer Design-Space Exploration
summary: Photonic neural accelerators offer ultra-low latency linear algebra, yet their usable numerical precision, sustainable throughput, and application accuracy remain tightly bounded by surrounding electro-optical interfaces and physical non-idealities. Pre-fabrication design-space exploration (DSE) requires a cross-layer electronic design automation (EDA) framework capable of evaluating disparate optical topologies under identical neural workloads and physical assumptions. We present \textbf{PISim}, a unified Photonic Inference Simulator that couples pretrained deep neural network execution with physics-based models of six accelerator architecture families, six electro-optic modulator technologies, four optical source organizations, and direct or coherent readout schemes. PISim embeds stage-resolved impairment operators---covering control and analog-to-digital quantization, finite extinction ratio, shot noise, correlated relative-intensity noise (RIN), thermal drift, propagation loss, and channel crosstalk---alongside an analytical cycle-level interface timing model to expose electronic-optical bottlenecks. Using simulated MNIST multilayer perceptron (MLP) benchmarks, we demonstrate how PISim identifies optimal precision operating points under multi-impairment stress (peaking at 6 bits for Mach--Zehnder and microring modulators), quantifies a 52.5 percentage-point accuracy gap between VCSEL-array and parallel-fanout laser architectures arising, under the modeled conditions, from power partitioning and correlated source noise, and models interface-limited throughput scaling across emitter-array widths from 32 to 128 channels. This comprehensive framework establishes an extensible, reproducible foundation for accuracy-constrained Pareto optimization prior to photonic tape-out.

AI.tldr: 论文提出统一的光子推理仿真器 PISim，将预训练深度神经网络执行与多类光子加速器架构、调制器、光源和读出方案的物理模型耦合，并纳入分阶段损伤与接口时序模型；在 MNIST MLP 基准上用于评估精度、准确率差距和吞吐 Scaling。
AI.motivation: 光子神经加速器具有超低延迟线性代数能力，但其可用数值精度、可持续吞吐和应用准确率受电光接口及物理非理想性限制；制造前设计空间探索需要跨层 EDA 框架，以便在相同神经工作负载和物理假设下评估不同光学拓扑。
AI.method: PISim 将预训练 DNN 执行与六类加速器架构、六种电光调制器技术、四种光源组织和直接或相干读出方案的物理模型结合；嵌入分阶段损伤算子，覆盖控制与模数量化、有限消光比、散粒噪声、相关 RIN、热漂移、传播损耗和通道串扰，并加入解析的周期级接口时序模型以暴露电光瓶颈。
AI.result: 基于模拟的 MNIST MLP 基准，PISim 在多损伤压力下识别最佳精度工作点，Mach-Zehnder 和微环调制器峰值均为 6 bit；量化 VCSEL 阵列与并行扇出激光架构之间 52.5 个百分点的准确率差距，在建模条件下源于功率分配和相关光源噪声；并建模 32 至 128 通道发射阵列宽度下的接口受限吞吐扩展。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为光子流片前的精度约束 Pareto 优化提供了可扩展、可复现的基础。

title: Self-Regulated Cosmic-Ray Electron Acceleration in High-Mach-Number MHD-PIC Shocks
summary: Shock waves in supernova remnants are thought to accelerate cosmic rays (CRs) via diffusive shock acceleration (DSA). If acceleration is efficient, CR-modified shock models and nonlinear DSA predict smoothly decelerated precursors and concave spectra that harden with energy. These predictions are in tension with observations, which favor spectra closer to the test-particle form, $4 πf(p) p^{4} = {\rm const}$ or steeper. We use one- and two-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic-particle-in-cell simulations to follow the long-term nonlinear coupling of the thermal plasma and CR electrons in non-relativistic quasi-parallel, high-Mach-number shocks. We choose electrons over ions for their larger charge per unit mass, probing the limits of current-driven feedback. We vary the supplied CR-electron mass fraction to measure the shock's response. Our injection model determines the effective injection and acceleration from particle trajectories through the evolving upstream turbulence, rather than a prescribed shock injection fraction. The reflected CR-electron current excites Bell-type non-resonant turbulence. The resulting magnetic structures scatter and isotropize the current-carrying particles, limiting the coherent upstream current and suppressing the formation of a spatially extended CR-pressure precursor. Across the CR-electron mass supply explored, the saturated upstream magnetic energy and far-upstream CR current converge to similar levels. In 1D, the downstream high-energy spectrum approaches the test-particle DSA shape across the resolved momentum range, with nonthermal pressure reaching a few tens of percent of the upstream ram pressure. These results suggest that, once injection is sufficient to sustain strong current-driven turbulence, supernova-remnant shocks can approach a common regulated state largely insensitive to the details of CR injection.

AI.tldr: 该文利用一维和二维磁流体-粒子网格（MHD-PIC）模拟研究非相对论、准平行、高马赫数超新星遗迹激波中热等离子体与宇宙线（CR）电子的长期非线性耦合。反射CR电子电流激发Bell型非共振湍流，磁结构散射并使载流粒子各向同性化，从而限制相干上游电流并抑制扩展的CR压强前驱；下游高能谱趋近测试粒子DSA形状。
AI.motivation: 检验高效扩散激波加速（DSA）和CR修正激波模型所预言的平滑减速前驱、随能量变硬的凹谱，与观测偏好测试粒子谱（4πf(p)p^4=常数或更陡）之间的矛盾；并探究电子情形下电流驱动反馈的极限以及结果对CR注入细节的敏感性。
AI.method: 采用一维和二维MHD-PIC模拟，追踪非相对论、准平行、高马赫数激波中热等离子体与CR电子的长期非线性耦合；选择CR电子是因为其荷质比更大，可探测电流驱动反馈极限；改变供给的CR电子质量分数以测量激波响应；注入模型不预设激波注入分数，而由粒子在演化上游湍流中的轨迹确定有效注入与加速。
AI.result: 反射CR电子电流激发Bell型非共振湍流；产生的磁结构散射并使载流粒子各向同性化，限制相干上游电流，抑制空间扩展的CR压强前驱。在所考察的CR电子质量供给范围内，饱和上游磁能和远上游CR电流趋于相近水平。一维模拟中，下游高能谱在已分辨动量范围内接近测试粒子DSA形状，非热压强达到上游冲压的百分之几十。摘要未给出具体质量分数范围及饱和水平数值。
AI.conclusion: 结果暗示，只要注入足以维持强电流驱动湍流，超新星遗迹激波可趋于一种共同调控状态，且对CR注入细节不敏感；这有助于缓解非线性DSA预言与观测谱形之间的张力。摘要未提供二维谱形、具体参数依赖或定量收敛值的细节。

title: Improving Nonequilibrium Thermal Conduction in CaF2 by Breaking the Phonon Bottleneck Effect
summary: Heat dissipation in laser optical materials depends not only on their thermal conductivity but also on how absorbed energy is redistributed among various phonon modes. In calcium fluoride (CaF2), rapid energy transfer from hot electrons to weakly propagating longitudinal optical (LO) phonons can create a nonequilibrium phonon bottleneck effect that limits efficient heat removal. Here, we propose selective phonon excitation as an effective strategy to break this bottleneck. Combining electron-phonon scattering calculations, phonon Boltzmann transport analysis, and nonequilibrium molecular dynamics simulations, we identify LO phonons as the primary modes that preferentially receive energy from hot carriers, leading to energy accumulation due to their inefficient transport and relaxation. Guided by three-phonon scattering phase-space analysis, selective excitation of transverse acoustic (TA) modes can accelerate LO relaxation and promote energy transfer toward heat-carrying acoustic modes. While sustained LO-phonon excitation reduces the thermal conductivity by approximately 12%, additional TA-mode excitation improves heat conduction by approximately 21% compared to the state limited by the LO-phonon bottleneck, surpassing the unexcited value. These findings demonstrate that controlling interbranch energy redistribution can counteract phonon-bottleneck-induced heat accumulation and reveal a working route for active thermal management in laser optical materials through selective control of phonon populations.

AI.tldr: 该文提出通过选择性激发声子来打破CaF2中由纵向光学声子引起的非平衡声子瓶颈，从而改善激光光学材料的散热；计算表明，额外激发横向声学声子可促进能量向导热声学模式转移并提升热导率。
AI.motivation: 激光光学材料的散热不仅取决于热导率，还取决于吸收能量在不同声子模式间的再分配。在CaF2中，热电子向传播较弱的LO声子快速传能会形成非平衡声子瓶颈，限制高效排热，因此需要寻找打破该瓶颈的策略。
AI.method: 提出选择性声子激发策略，并结合电子-声子散射计算、声子玻尔兹曼输运分析和非平衡分子动力学模拟，识别优先接收热载流子能量的声子模式；进一步利用三声子散射相空间分析指导TA模式的选择性激发，以加速LO声子弛豫并促进能量向载热声学模式转移。
AI.result: 研究发现LO声子是主要优先接收热载流子能量的模式，并因其输运和弛豫效率低而导致能量积累。持续激发LO声子会使热导率降低约12%；在此基础上额外激发TA模式，相比受LO声子瓶颈限制的状态可使热导率提高约21%，并超过未激发时的数值。
AI.conclusion: 通过控制声子支间的能量再分配，可以抵消声子瓶颈导致的热积累；选择性调控声子布居为激光光学材料的主动热管理提供了一条可行途径。

title: Divergent Interfacial Lifetimes without Bulk Criticality in Fully Miscible Fluids
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures; Supplemental Material available as an ancillary file
summary: A fully miscible interface must disappear at equilibrium, but its lifetime need not be governed by a bulk instability. We construct a spatially resolved, dissipative two-field model in which a prepared correlation-excited interface undergoes a localized saddle-node while its homogeneous excited surroundings remain metastable and the relaxed mixture is strictly one phase. The interfacial soft mode produces a deterministic first-passage time that grows as the inverse square root of the distance from the fold and couples directly to the evolving concentration-profile width.
