title: Elasto-inertial force exerted on a sphere oscillating in a fluid near a soft interface
summary: Fluid inertia can remain important in confined flows, even at low Reynolds number when convective inertia is negligible; yet its coupling with interface deformability is an open problem. Here, we theoretically investigate the high-frequency oscillations of an immersed sphere near an elastic wall in the lubrication regime. We first reconcile previous predictions for the added mass near a rigid wall by consistently matching the inner lubrication flow with the outer flow. Using this rigid-wall problem as a reference, we then develop a perturbative analysis of wall deformation and derive the leading elasto-inertial correction to the hydrodynamic force. Our results reveal that the coupling between interface softness and fluid inertia produces a dominant non-dissipative force contribution scaling as the power four of the frequency in the high-frequency limit, thus corresponding to the fourth time derivative of the sphere's position. This finding may have implications regarding the short-time dynamics of colloidal particles near deformable interfaces in biological and soft-matter settings.

AI.tldr: 该文在润滑区理论研究了浸没球体靠近弹性壁的高频振荡，先通过匹配内层润滑流与外层流统一刚性壁附加质量的既有预测，再以刚性壁为参考对壁面变形作微扰分析，得到弹性-惯性耦合下主导的非耗散力按频率四次方标度，对应球体位置的四阶时间导数。
AI.motivation: 受限流动中即使低雷诺数且对流惯性可忽略，流体惯性仍可能重要；但其与界面可变形性的耦合尚属开放问题，尤其缺乏对弹性壁附近球体高频动力学的理论认识。
AI.method: 采用理论分析与渐近匹配方法：在润滑近似下研究浸没球体 near 弹性壁的高频振荡；首先将内层润滑流与外层流一致匹配，以调和刚性壁附近附加质量的先前预测；随后以刚性壁问题为参考，对壁面变形进行微扰分析，推导 hydrodynamic force 的领头弹性-惯性修正。
AI.result: 结果表明，界面柔软性与流体惯性的耦合产生一个主导的非耗散力贡献；在高频极限下该贡献按频率的四次方标度，因而对应于球体位置的四阶时间导数。摘要未给出具体系数、参数范围或定量验证。
AI.conclusion: 弹性壁与流体惯性耦合可在高頻润滑流动中引入高阶非耗散动力学；这可能影响生物与软物质环境中胶体颗粒在可变形界面附近的短时动力学。摘要未提供实验验证或具体应用外推。

title: Gradient-Free Inverse Design of 3D Nanophotonic Devices Using the Level-Set-Method
summary: Advances in 3D nanophotonic additive manufacturing enable increasingly complex, almost free-form devices for manipulating light at sub-wavelength scales. Extending nanophotonic designs into three dimensions introduces additional degrees of freedom. Exploiting this freedom requires inverse-design methods that can efficiently navigate this large design space while accommodating fabrication constraints. Here, we combine gradient-free optimization with the level-set method (LSM) to provide such an approach for 3D additive manufacturing. Representing the 3D geometry as a level set constructed from Gaussian radial basis functions retains substantial geometric freedom with only a few hundred design variables. This compact representation makes gradient-free optimization practical for fully 3D nanophotonic devices, eliminating the need for adjoint calculations. This unlocks the use of any Maxwell solver or auxiliary algorithms that should express fabrication constraints for which the required derivatives are unavailable or impractical to obtain, and enables embarrassingly parallel workflows. Consequently, binary fabrication requirements, such as structural connectivity, can be rigorously enforced, avoiding the differentiable approximations commonly used in gradient-based optimization. Here, we demonstrate the combination of the gradient-free LSM with a connected-component analysis algorithm to enforce the structural integrity of the design. We demonstrate the applicability of the gradient-free LSM by optimizing a Y-splitter while strictly enforcing the structural integrity of the material and the void in the design.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种面向三维纳米光子增材制造的逆设计方法：用高斯径向基函数构造水平集表示三维几何，结合无梯度优化，在仅数百个设计变量下实现全三维器件优化，并严格施加二元制造约束。
AI.motivation: 三维纳米光子增材制造可制造复杂、近自由形状的亚波长光子器件，将设计扩展到三维会引入更多自由度；但需要逆设计方法能高效搜索大设计空间并满足制造约束，尤其是结构连通性等难以用可微近似严格保证的二元约束。
AI.method: 将三维几何表示为由高斯径向基函数构建的水平集，利用紧凑参数化保留较大几何自由度并减少设计变量；采用无梯度优化与水平集方法结合，避免伴随计算，从而可使用任意麦克斯韦求解器或用于表达制造约束的辅助算法；进一步结合连通分量分析算法严格施加结构完整性约束。
AI.result: 作者展示了无梯度水平集方法与连通分量分析结合来保证设计结构完整性，并优化了一个Y分束器，同时严格保证材料与空隙区域的结构完整性；摘要未提供具体性能指标或对比数据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使全三维纳米光子器件的无梯度逆设计变得可行，可严格施加二元制造约束、避免不可微近似，并支持无需导数的求解器及高度并行的工作流；摘要未给出更广泛的实验结论或定量结论。

title: Stretched bilayer-cytoskeleton links hold echinocytes in a model splenic slit
comment: 35 pages, 8 figures, 1 table; Supplementary Materials included (pages S1-S16, 6 figures, 1 table); Movies S1 to S3 are ancillary files. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Stored red blood cells become echinocytes, growing spicules before losing membrane; the spleen clears the resulting small, spherical cells. Whether spicules alone hinder splenic passage is unknown. Shape and area change together. In a two-component model whose shrinking cytoskeleton raises spicules, we drove a discocyte and stage I to III echinocytes of equal area and volume through a model splenic slit. The pressure drop needed to pass rose with stage; stage III echinocytes were held at 37 to 50 times the pressure drop that passed the discocyte. Bilayer-cytoskeleton links stretched near full extension held these cells; lengthening them about twofold released a held cell. Capillary-sized channels, as in our device, separated the stages far less. Of the shape classes in stored blood, the model held at high pressure drops only storage-induced microerythrocytes, which perfused human spleens clear most. Spicules, besides membrane loss, may decide which stored cells the spleen retains.

AI.tldr: 该文用双组分模型让等面积、等体积的盘状红细胞与I–III期棘红细胞通过模拟脾脏狭缝，发现棘化程度越高所需压差越大，III期可达盘状细胞的37–50倍；这种滞留与双层-细胞骨架连接接近全伸长有关，而毛细血管尺寸通道区分能力弱得多。
AI.motivation: 储存红细胞会形成棘红细胞并产生棘突，随后失去膜并变成小球形细胞而被脾脏清除；但棘突本身是否足以阻碍脾脏通过尚不清楚，且形状与面积同时变化使问题难以单独归因。
AI.method: 构建双组分模型，用收缩的细胞骨架抬高棘突；使面积和体积相同的盘状红细胞及I–III期棘红细胞通过模型脾脏狭缝，测定通过所需压差，并与毛细血管尺寸通道比较；还拉伸双层-细胞骨架连接以检验其对细胞滞留的作用。
AI.result: 通过模型脾脏狭缝所需压差随棘化分期升高；III期棘红细胞被卡住时所需压差为盘状细胞的37–50倍。接近全伸长的双层-细胞骨架连接参与维持滞留，将其长度增加约两倍可释放被卡住的细胞。毛细血管尺寸通道对各期的区分远小于脾脏狭缝。在所模拟的储存血形状类别中，仅储存诱导的微红细胞在高压力差下被滞留，而灌注人脾脏时大部分被清除。
AI.conclusion: 棘突除导致膜丢失外，还可能决定哪些储存红细胞被脾脏滞留；脾脏狭缝中的高压力差滞留与棘化分期及双层-细胞骨架连接伸展程度相关。

title: Laser-induced damage threshold of periodic plasmonic metasurfaces
summary: Plasmonic metasurfaces enable strong nonlinear optical responses due to sub-wavelength field confinement, yet their performance is fundamentally limited by low laser-induced damage thresholds (LIDT). Here, we present a comprehensive experimental and numerical study of the interplay between surface lattice resonances (SLRs), second-harmonic generation (SHG), and LIDT in periodic gold nanobar metasurfaces. Angle-resolved measurements reveal that excitation of SLRs at the fundamental wavelength strongly enhances SHG efficiency while simultaneously reducing the LIDT. In contrast, excitation of an SLR at the second-harmonic wavelength does not affect the damage threshold, allowing the SHG signal to be maximized. Our findings establish a fundamental trade-off between nonlinear efficiency and optical robustness and provide design guidelines for optimizing periodic plasmonic metasurfaces for high-power nonlinear applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统分析周期金纳米条超表面中表面晶格共振（SLR）、二次谐波产生（SHG）与激光损伤阈值（LIDT）的相互作用，发现基频SLR增强SHG但降低LIDT，而二次谐波波长的SLR不影响损伤阈值，从而可实现SHG信号最大化，揭示了非线性效率与光学鲁棒性之间的基本权衡。
AI.motivation: 等离激元超表面依靠亚波长场局域实现强非线性光学响应，但激光诱导损伤阈值低，根本性限制其性能；因此需要理解SLR、SHG与LIDT之间的相互影响，为高功率非线性应用提供优化依据。
AI.method: 结合实验与数值模拟研究周期金纳米条超表面，采用角度分辨测量，考察在基频波长和二次谐波波长激发SLR时对SHG效率与LIDT的影响。
AI.result: 在基频波长激发SLR会显著增强SHG效率，同时降低LIDT；在二次谐波波长激发SLR不影响损伤阈值，因而可使SHG信号最大化。摘要未提供具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了非线性效率与光学鲁棒性之间的基本权衡，并为优化周期等离激元超表面以用于高功率非线性应用提供了设计准则。

title: Crystal Nucleation Driven by Microjets from Hydrodynamically Interacting Thermocavitation Bubbles
summary: Primary nucleation predominantly dictates the physicochemical, optical and mechanical properties of crystals emerging from solution. Here, we reveal a previously unrecognized nucleation mechanism arising from bubble-bubble hydrodynamic interactions using laser-induced thermocavitation bubble pairs. Under confinement, antiphase generation of two bubbles produces a micron-scale, high-speed liquid jet. Upon impact with the surrounding supersaturated liquid, this microjet generates intense localized shear, thereby inducing crystallization of the model inorganic salt, potassium permanganate. Under identical laser energies and supersaturation levels, crystallization was not observed in single-bubble experiments, in which no microjet was present. We show that the crystallization probability increases with microjet velocity. Boundary integral simulations reveal how experimental parameters such as confinement, bubble spacing, and laser energy govern microjet formation and velocity. We quantify the relationship between jet velocity and the observed enhancement in crystal nucleation kinetics by incorporating shear into the kinetic prefactor in classical nucleation theory. By combining experiments, theory, and simulations, we establish how microjets emerging from bubble-bubble hydrodynamic interactions may influence crystallization kinetics, opening new opportunities for the manufacture of crystalline materials.

AI.tldr: 该文利用激光诱导热空化气泡对，在受限条件下通过反相生成的两个气泡产生微米级高速液体射流；射流撞击过饱和液体产生局部强剪切，从而诱导模型无机盐高锰酸钾结晶。相同激光能量和过饱和度下，单气泡实验无微射流且未观察到结晶；结晶概率随微射流速度增加。作者结合边界积分模拟与经典成核理论中动力学前因子的剪切修正，建立微射流与成核动力学增强之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 初生成核主导从溶液中形成的晶体的物理化学、光学和力学性质。作者旨在揭示此前未被认识的气泡-气泡流体动力学相互作用所引发的成核机制，并理解由此产生的微射流如何影响结晶动力学，为晶态材料制造提供新机会。
AI.method: 采用激光诱导热空化气泡对实验，在受限条件下反相生成两个气泡并产生微米级高速液体射流；射流冲击周围过饱和液体并产生局部强剪切，以高锰酸钾为模型无机盐。将气泡对实验与相同激光能量和过饱和度下的单气泡实验对照，并考察结晶概率与微射流速度的关系。利用边界积分模拟分析受限条件、气泡间距和激光能量等参数对微射流形成及速度的控制作用；将剪切纳入经典成核理论的动力学前因子，量化射流速度与成核动力学增强的关系。
AI.result: 气泡对产生的微射流可诱导高锰酸钾结晶；在相同激光能量和过饱和度下，无微射流的单气泡实验未观察到结晶。结晶概率随微射流速度增加。边界积分模拟表明受限条件、气泡间距和激光能量等实验参数决定微射流的形成与速度。将剪切引入经典成核理论的动力学前因子后，可量化射流速度与观察到的晶体成核动力学增强之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 由气泡-气泡流体动力学相互作用产生的微射流会影响结晶动力学；作者通过实验、理论和模拟相结合建立了这一影响关系，并为晶态材料制造提供了新机会。

title: Ultrahigh-speed digital holography reveals blood flow beneath the skin
summary: Laser Doppler holography (LDH) leverages ultrahigh-speed digital holography to reveal blood-flow signals in vessels beneath the skin of the closed eyelid and around the eye. We demonstrate this in one volunteer using recordings acquired at approximately 16,000 frames/s under 10~mW of diffuse near-infrared illumination. Numerical Fresnel reconstruction and principal-component filtering reveal branching vascular patterns. These results extend an ocular imaging system to blood-flow visualization beneath the skin without requiring elaborate immobilization procedures.

AI.tldr: 该文演示了激光多普勒全息术（LDH）可在闭合眼睑皮肤下及眼周可视化血流信号：对1名志愿者以约16,000帧/秒、10 mW漫射近红外照明记录，经菲涅尔数值重建与主成分滤波得到分支血管图案。
AI.motivation: 将眼部成像系统扩展到皮肤下血流可视化，并避免复杂或繁琐的固定程序。
AI.method: 采用超高速数字全息与激光多普勒全息术，在1名志愿者上以约16,000帧/秒采集数据，使用10 mW漫射近红外照明；随后进行菲涅尔数值重建和主成分滤波以提取血流信号与血管图案。
AI.result: 成功显示闭合眼睑皮肤下及眼周的分支血管模式与血流信号；摘要未提供定量血流速度、信噪比或统计性能指标。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持LDH用于无需复杂固定程序的皮肤下眼部血流可视化，但仅为单名志愿者的可行性演示，尚需更多受试者与定量评估验证。

title: Soft material mechanical property degradation at high strain rates
summary: The rheometry of soft, tissue-like materials at ultra-high strain rates is critical to biomechanics, materials science, and medical engineering. One approach for characterizing high-rate material response is Inertial Microcavitation Rheometry (IMR), which infers viscoelastic constitutive behavior from the measured radius-time history of a laser-induced cavitation bubble. At these rates, materials may exhibit history-dependent behavior, including damage, fracture, and plasticity. However, conventional IMR analyses typically assume constant material properties throughout the cavitation event, limiting their ability to capture such changes. We present an IMR framework for identifying effective time varying material properties from measured cavitation radius histories. The framework allows the shear modulus, viscosity, or both to evolve during the event using normalized sigmoid histories. Synthetic tests recover prescribed constant and time varying material histories. Application to polyacrylamide and gelatin datasets yields effective material-property histories across formulations and experimental conditions. Viscosity decreased across the datasets, while the extent of shear modulus reduction varied with material and formulation. When both properties decreased, their reductions could occur at different stages of cavitation. This distinction in mechanical property degradation depends on both the property and its evolution during high-strain events.

AI.tldr: 提出一种惯性微空化流变学（IMR）框架，可从激光诱导空化泡的半径-时间历史反演有效时变材料属性；合成测试验证了常量和时变材料历史的恢复，并在聚丙烯酰胺和明胶数据中揭示粘度下降及剪切模量下降程度随材料和配方而变化。
AI.motivation: 超高速率下软组织类材料可能表现出损伤、断裂和塑性等历史相关行为，而传统IMR分析通常假设空化事件期间材料属性恒定，难以捕捉这些变化。
AI.method: 在IMR框架中允许剪切模量、粘度或二者在空化事件中演化，并用归一化Sigmoid历史描述其变化；基于测得的空化半径历史识别有效时变材料属性，并通过合成测试检验对预设常量和时变材料历史的恢复能力。
AI.result: 合成测试可恢复预设的常量及时变材料历史；应用于聚丙烯酰胺和明胶数据集时，可获得不同配方和实验条件下的有效材料属性历史。所有数据集中粘度均下降，剪切模量降低程度随材料和配方变化；当二者均下降时，其降低可发生在空化过程的不同阶段。摘要未提供具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够从空化半径历史中识别有效时变材料属性，并区分机械性能退化所依赖的属性及其在高应变事件中的演化，从而扩展IMR对历史相关材料行为的表征能力。

title: A Field-Deployable 2U Ultra-Stable Laser with Sub-Hertz Linewidth Based on Optoelectronic Oscillator Locking
summary: Compact, high-performance ultra-stable lasers that can operate outside the laboratory remain a long-standing goal. Here we report, to our knowledge, the most compact field-deployable ultra-stable laser, packaged in a standard 2U rack chassis. It is stabilized to a 50 mm-long, 19 mL optical reference cavity with low vibration sensitivity by optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) locking, an approach particularly suited to compact, transportable systems. The laser delivers an integrated linewidth of about 0.42 Hz and a fractional frequency stability of about 5E-15 at 1 s averaging time (about 2.2E-15 at 0.4 s). Measured phase noise approaches the cavity thermal-noise limit below 100 Hz and the theoretical OEO-locking limit from 100 Hz to 100 kHz. The system volume is roughly one quarter of the volume of previously reported integrated, transportable ultra-stable lasers of comparable performance, making it well suited for field applications in time-frequency metrology, quantum technologies, and environmental sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种封装于标准2U机箱、可现场部署的紧凑型超稳激光系统，采用光电振荡器锁定50 mm长、19 mL的低振动敏感度光学参考腔，实现约0.42 Hz积分线宽和1 s平均时间约5E-15的频率稳定度，体积约为同类集成可运输超稳激光系统的四分之一。
AI.motivation: 紧凑、高性能且能在实验室外运行的超稳激光器一直是长期目标；本文旨在实现可现场部署、性能可与已有集成可运输系统相比且体积更小的超稳激光系统。
AI.method: 将超稳激光系统封装在标准2U机架机箱中，锁定到50 mm长、19 mL、低振动敏感度的光学参考腔；采用光电振荡器（OEO）锁定方案，作者认为该方案特别适合紧凑、可运输系统。
AI.result: 激光器积分线宽约0.42 Hz；分数频率稳定度在1 s平均时间约5E-15，在0.4 s约2.2E-15；相位噪声在100 Hz以下接近腔热噪声极限，在100 Hz至100 kHz范围内接近OEO锁定理论极限；系统体积约为此前报道的、性能相当的集成可运输超稳激光系统的四分之一。摘要未提供功耗、重量、具体尺寸及环境适应性等细节。
AI.conclusion: 该系统是目前已知最紧凑的可现场部署超稳激光器之一，体积显著小于性能相当的系统，适用于时间频率计量、量子技术和环境传感等现场应用。

title: Fragility of Aeolian Ripples
summary: Sand surfaces exposed to the wind are covered by aeolian sand waves of diverse wavelengths, from centimetres for small ripples to decameters for dunes. Sand dunes can be said to be antifragile, since their growth is not prohibited by storms, whereas ripples and megaripples are fragile since they get flattened. The fluid-entrainment hypothesis attributes their fragility to a common cause: the spontaneous aerodynamic entrainment of grains. Here, we challenge this conventional view by revealing its major shortcomings and inconsistencies. An alternative framework, routed in the granular bed rheology, posits that impact ripples are erased when the two-phase flow of ballistically hopping grains on a solid sand surface gives way to a three-phase flow, featuring an intermediate, collision-dominated, fluid-like transport layer. Notably, both martian wind-drag ripples and terrestrial aerodynamic ripples, which emerge via a hydrodynamic instability, are insensitive to such "surface-melting". Their destruction is predicated on the transition from aerodynamically smooth to rough conditions, instead. Our theoretical arguments are well supported by a stability diagram in terms of Shields number and grain diameter, assembled from a carefully reassessed large body of literature, and backed up by dedicated control measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文反驳将风成沙波纹和巨波纹易被风暴抹平归因于自发气动起沙的传统流体夹带假说，提出基于颗粒床流变学的替代框架：冲击波纹在被弹跳颗粒两相流向含碰撞主导流体状输运层的三相流转变时消失；火星风阻波纹和地球气动波纹对“表面熔化”不敏感，其破坏取决于气动光滑至粗糙条件的转变，并由Shields数-粒径稳定性图和对照测量支持。
AI.motivation: 解释沙丘表现为“反脆弱”、而波纹和巨波纹表现为“脆弱”的差异，并检验传统流体夹带假说。摘要指出该假说存在重大缺陷和不一致，因此作者寻求基于颗粒床流变学的替代解释。
AI.method: 采用理论论证，提出颗粒床流变学框架；重新审视大量文献并构建以Shields数和粒径为坐标的稳定性图；辅以专门的对照测量。摘要未提供具体实验设置、样本量或定量参数。
AI.result: 揭示了传统流体夹带解释的缺陷；提出冲击波纹因弹跳颗粒两相流向碰撞主导的三相流转变而被抹平；火星风阻波纹和地球气动波纹由流体动力不稳定性产生，对“表面熔化”不敏感，其破坏对应气动光滑至粗糙条件的转变；稳定性图和对照测量支持上述理论。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 传统自发气动夹带观点受到挑战，基于颗粒床流变学的替代框架得到文献重评估和控制测量支持；但摘要未提供定量阈值及完整机制细节。

title: High-directivity pulsed beams for effective power and information transfer
summary: A vector spherical wave expansion (VSWE) is used to engineer an elemental multipole source whose radiated field is a superdirective, extremely unidirectional (SDEU) needle beam. It is proved analytically and confirmed numerically that the element attains Harrington's normal-directivity value along its beam axis. Its radiated field is linearly polarized with an azimuthally symmetric magnitude; its back lobe vanishes identically in the far field. The unidirectional behavior is quantified at any finite far-field radius by a closed-form front-to-back ratio, obtained from an exact per-degree cancellation of the electric and magnetic multipole contributions in the backward direction. Uniform circular arrays (UCAs) of these elements inherit the SDEU behavior. Driving the arrays with zero-area pulses (ZAPs) transfers the frequency-domain performance intact into the time domain. It is shown that whether the radiated energy beam is narrower or wider than the corresponding intensity beam is decided by a single property of the radiated waveform, not by the size of the radiating aperture. A simple single-cycle ZAP is used to quantify the performance of the UCAs; its energy beam is the narrower one. The same criterion is shown to govern the focal spot of near-field-focused pulse-driven arrays. A custom-designed intensity-enhancement (IE) ZAP is introduced that raises the focal intensity by almost 200-fold over a narrow-band reference while producing a focal spot more than ten times smaller in both the axial and transverse directions, deeply subwavelength with respect to its own effective wavelength. It is demonstrated that these stunning IE results are produced simply with an array of pulse-excited Huygens dipole sources. These results identify the pulse shape, rather than the aperture, as the design variable that governs localized electromagnetic energy and information delivery.

AI.tldr: 本文用矢量球面波展开设计超指向、极单向的针状波束多极子源，并将其推广到均匀圆阵与脉冲激励；研究表明决定能量波束与强度波束宽窄的是波形特性而非孔径，并据此设计强度增强零面积脉冲，显著提升聚焦强度并缩小焦斑。
AI.motivation: 摘要未单独陈述研究动机；从内容看，研究旨在获得超指向、极单向的针状波束源，并将频率域性能完整转移到时间域，进而以脉冲形状而非孔径作为调控局部电磁能量与信息投送的设计变量。
AI.method: 采用矢量球面波展开（VSWE）构造单元多极子源，并用解析证明与数值验证评估其方向性、极化、后瓣和闭式前后比；将该单元组成均匀圆阵（UCA），用零面积脉冲（ZAP）驱动，并以单周期ZAP量化阵列性能；进一步引入定制强度增强（IE）ZAP，并用脉冲激励的Huygens偶极子源阵列实现聚焦增强。
AI.result: 该单元沿波束轴达到Harrington normal-directivity值，辐射场线极化且幅度方位对称，远场后瓣恒为零；其单向性由逐阶精确抵消电、磁多极子后向贡献得到的闭式前后比量化。UCA继承该超指向极单向行为，ZAP驱动可将频域性能完整转移到时域。能量波束相对强度波束的宽窄由辐射波形的一个属性决定，而非孔径大小；单周期ZAP的能量波束更窄，同一判据也支配近场聚焦脉冲阵列的焦斑。定制IE ZAP使焦斑强度较窄带参考提高近200倍，轴向与横向焦斑尺寸均缩小十倍以上，且相对其自身有效波长为深亚波长；该结果仅用脉冲激励的Huygens偶极子源阵列即可实现。
AI.conclusion: 脉冲形状而非辐射孔径是控制局部电磁能量与信息投送的关键设计变量；通过VSWE多极子单元、UCA和ZAP/IE ZAP设计，可在时域获得超指向、极单向及深度亚波长聚焦增强的辐射性能。

title: Learning Nonlinear Transient Dynamics in Fluid Flow Networks with the Neural Basis Method
summary: Fluid flow networks, from pipeline infrastructure to biological vasculature, are governed by nonlinear edgewise hyperbolic laws coupled through continuity and conservation at junctions. Many-query tasks require rapid evaluation across unseen parametric settings, but conventional methods re-solve the system for each query at prohibitive cost. Existing physics-informed neural approaches impose the governing equations through penalty losses over generic neural approximators; these losses act only as optimization surrogates, with no guarantee that their reduction reduces solution error, and the resulting optimization is prone to ill-conditioning, particularly for hyperbolic systems. Building on the "representation-then-projection" principle of the neural basis method, we introduce a new approach for modeling fluid flow networks. Fixed neural bases define the representation space on each edge, while projection of the discretized equations determines the expansion coefficients, embedding edgewise laws into a conservative formulation. Edge subdomains are coupled through non-overlapping domain decomposition, and a neural operator learns, directly in this reduced space, the parametric map to the expansion coefficients. On looped and branching network topologies, we reproduce references with relative $L^2$ errors below 0.02%, whereas the physics-informed neural network baseline fails. Across unseen boundary conditions in both interpolation and extrapolation, we maintain mean pressure errors below 1% and mean flux errors below 3.3%, while the physics-informed DeepONet baseline reaches 8-18% pressure errors and 85-95% flux errors. These results highlight the framework's potential for real-time monitoring, design exploration, and uncertainty quantification of fluid flow networks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于神经基表示与投影的流体流动网络降阶建模框架，通过固定神经基、方程投影和域分解确定展开系数，并用神经算子学习参数到系数的映射；在环状与分支网络上取得低于0.02%的相对L2误差，并在未见边界条件下保持较低压力与通量误差。
AI.motivation: 流体流动网络受非线性逐边双曲律及节点连续性/守恒耦合支配，许多查询任务需要快速评估未见参数，但传统方法每次查询都要重新求解，成本过高；现有物理信息神经网络仅用惩罚损失施加方程，损失下降不保证解误差下降，且对双曲系统优化易病态。
AI.method: 基于神经基方法“先表示、再投影”的原则：在每条边上用固定神经基定义表示空间，通过离散方程投影确定展开系数，将逐边定律嵌入保守 formulation；采用非重叠区域分解耦合边子域，并让神经算子直接在该降阶空间中学习参数到展开系数的映射。
AI.result: 在环状和分支网络拓扑上复现参考解，相对L2误差低于0.02%，而物理信息神经网络基线失败；在插值与外推的未见边界条件下，平均压力误差低于1%、平均通量误差低于3.3%；物理信息DeepONet基线达到8–18%压力误差和85–95%通量误差。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该框架在流体流动网络的实时监测、设计探索和不确定性量化方面具有潜力。

title: AI-assisted search for self-compressing gigawatt subcycle field waveforms
summary: We explore the physics behind pulse self-compression to high-power subcycle field waveforms and search for the optimal regimes of such compression over the parameter space as laid out by multimode nonlinear dynamics of ultrashort laser pulses in gas-filled hollow fibers. With the pertinent physical criteria for pulse contrast and no pulse breakup formalized as operational stopping rules, a radical speedup of such search is achieved by delegating its tedious preliminary stages to generative pretrained transformer models. The precise adjustment of self-compression dynamics vis-a-vis the desired compressed pulse output is, however, not yet delegable to AI agents, as the criteria for such search are still largely subjective, operating with fine aspects of subcycle field structure, not yet formalizable as clear search-stopping instructions. An ultimate precision in such subcycle field engineering is attainable via a management of field-phase-sensitive nonlinear processes, enabling pulse self-compression to high-power subcycle field waveforms and opening paths toward fiber-optic attosecond lightwave engineering.

AI.tldr: 研究了气体填充空芯光纤中多模非线性动力学驱动的脉冲自压缩至高功率亚周期场波形的物理机制与最优参数区，利用生成式预训练Transformer显著加速搜索，并指出AI尚不能替代最终精密调控，需借助场相位敏感非线性过程实现极致精度。
AI.motivation: 探索脉冲自压缩到高功率亚周期场波形的物理机制，并在多模非线性动力学参数空间中寻找最佳压缩区；同时将脉冲对比度和避免脉冲分裂等物理判据形式化为操作停止规则，以加速最优区搜索。
AI.method: 在多模非线性动力学框架下考察气体填充空芯光纤中少周期脉冲的自压缩参数空间；将脉冲对比度与无脉冲分裂等判据形式化为搜索停止规则；把繁琐的初步搜索阶段交由生成式预训练Transformer完成；最终精密调控依赖对场相位敏感非线性过程的管理。
AI.result: 生成式预训练Transformer使搜索显著提速；但针对所需压缩脉冲输出的精确自压缩动力学调节仍不能交给AI代理，因为相关搜索判据仍高度主观，涉及亚周期场结构的细微方面，尚不能形式化为明确的搜索停止指令；摘要未给出定量压缩指标。通过场相位敏感非线性过程管理可实现亚周期场工程的极致精度，支持高功率亚周期场波形自压缩并通向光纤阿秒光波工程。
AI.conclusion: AI可加速前期参数搜索，但最终精密调节仍受制于尚未形式化的主观判据；场相位敏感非线性过程管理是实现高功率亚周期脉冲自压缩和光纤阿秒光波工程的关键路径。

title: Long-lived light-driven bimagnons at finite momentum in NiO
summary: Light can manipulate magnetic order and its excitations on ultrafast timescales, including through resonantly driven phonons. In antiferromagnets, light can also create correlated magnon pairs, or bimagnons. Unlike single magnons, whose damping has been measured and modeled in detail, little is known about the lifetime, interactions and decay of such correlated pairs: prior two-magnon measurements show broad linewidths or coherences that dephase within 200 fs. Here we pump the phonon-assisted two-magnon absorption of NiO with mid-infrared pulses, far below its bandgap, and probe the resulting magnetic dynamics at finite momentum with time-resolved resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS). Upon photoexcitation, the one-magnon linewidth and energy are essentially unchanged, indicating that the long-range magnetic order is preserved without the photocarrier-induced demagnetization characteristic of above-bandgap excitation. A pump-induced two-magnon signal appears on the energy-gain (anti-Stokes) side of the spectrum. Its spectral weight peaks 4 ps after the pump, well beyond our 0.5 ps time resolution, indicative of a delayed growth likely due to momentum redistribution of the light-induced magnon pairs across the Brillouin zone. This two-magnon signal decays with a time constant of $28\pm11$ ps, exceeding the previously reported two-magnon dephasing time by more than two orders of magnitude. These results establish long-lived light-driven bimagnon correlations beyond the one-magnon state, akin to the higher-order correlations measured in ultracold gases.

AI.tldr: 该文用中红外脉冲泵浦NiO的声子辅助双磁振子吸收，并用时间分辨共振非弹性X射线散射在有限动量探测磁动力学。泵浦后单磁振子线宽和能量基本不变，而能量增益侧出现双磁振子信号，约4 ps达峰，并以28±11 ps时间常数衰减，表明光驱动双磁振子关联寿命比此前报道的退相位时间高两个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 光可在超快时间尺度调控磁序及其激发，反铁磁体中还可产生相关磁振子对（双磁振子）。单磁振子的阻尼已被详细测量和建模，但双磁振子的寿命、相互作用和衰减知之甚少；此前双磁振子测量仅显示宽线宽或200 fs内退相干的相干性。
AI.method: 对NiO进行中红外泵浦，激发远低于带隙的声子辅助双磁振子吸收，并用时间分辨共振非弹性X射线散射在有限动量探测泵浦后的磁动力学，跟踪单磁振子线宽与能量以及能量增益侧双磁振子信号的光谱权重随时间演化。摘要未提供泵浦通量、样品温度等具体实验参数。
AI.result: 泵浦后单磁振子线宽和能量基本不变，说明长程磁序保持，未出现 Above-bandgap 激发特有的光生载流子诱导退磁。能量增益（反斯托克斯）侧出现泵浦诱导双磁振子信号，其光谱权重在泵浦后4 ps达峰，远超0.5 ps时间分辨率，提示光诱导磁振子对在布里渊区内动量再分布导致延迟增长；该信号以28±11 ps时间常数衰减，比此前报道的双磁振子退相位时间高两个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了超越单磁振子态的长寿命光驱动双磁振子关联，类似超冷气体中测量的高阶关联，并表明低于带隙的声子辅助激发可在保持长程磁序的同时产生长寿命相关磁振子对。

title: A deployed four-city entanglement-based QKD network with real-time key delivery, benchmarked against finite-key security bounds
summary: Quantum key distribution (QKD) generates shared secret keys whose security rests on the laws of physics rather than on computational assumptions. We report the entanglement-based segment of the Slovak national quantum communication infrastructure, connecting four cities in western Slovakia over deployed telecommunication fiber. Polarization-entangled photons generated at a central node are passively routed by wavelength to form a trusted-node-free, fully meshed sub-network of three cities, with the fourth connected through the central node and all links operated simultaneously. We also introduce a matrix formalism for passive wavelength routing that enables the algorithmic construction of uniquely and fully connected topologies. Unlike most previous demonstrations, which estimate key rates from raw coincidences, all rates reported here are obtained after the complete post-processing chain, with keys delivered in real time via ETSI GS QKD 014. With partial non-local chromatic dispersion compensation, we obtain 13.5 bit/s over 109 km, and 4.3 bit/s over 32.1 dB of accumulated loss between two cities without a direct fiber link. Benchmarking against finite-key security bounds shows that the implemented heuristic privacy amplification can exceed the finite-key bound, and that replacing detect-and-discard with error correction would increase the finite-key rate by a factor of 4.1-6.6, and yield a positive finite-key rate on the 142.9 km link where the implemented scheme yields none.

AI.tldr: 在斯洛伐克西部四城现网光纤上构建基于纠缠的QKD网络段，利用中心纠缠源和无源波长路由实现三城无可信节点全网格及第四城经中心节点接入，并报告完整后处理后的实时成钥速率；109 km链路达13.5 bit/s，32.1 dB累积损耗链路达4.3 bit/s，有限密钥基准显示改用纠错可显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: QKD的安全性基于物理定律而非计算假设；该工作旨在建设并验证国家量子通信基础设施中的基于纠缠网络段，在现网电信光纤上实现无可信节点、全网格的多城连接，并以完整后处理后的真实成钥速率和有限密钥安全界进行评估，而非仅用原始符合计数估算密钥率。
AI.method: 在斯洛伐克西部四城部署光纤网络；中心节点产生偏振纠缠光子，通过无源波长路由分配，形成三城无可信节点全网格子网，第四城经中心节点连接，所有链路同时运行；提出被动波长路由的矩阵形式化方法，以算法构造唯一且全连接的拓扑；采用部分非局部色散补偿；所有密钥经完整后处理链并依据ETSI GS QKD 014实时交付；利用有限密钥安全界进行基准测试。
AI.result: 在109 km链路上获得13.5 bit/s；在两座无直连光纤城市之间、32.1 dB累积损耗下获得4.3 bit/s；有限密钥基准表明，所实现的启发式隐私放大可超过有限密钥界；若以纠错替代检测后丢弃，有限密钥率可提高4.1至6.6倍，并在142.9 km链路上获得正值有限密钥率，而当前实现在该链路上无有限密钥率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了在现网光纤上构建无可信节点、全网格且实时交付密钥的多城纠缠QKD网络段的可行性；被动波长路由矩阵形式化可支持唯一全连接拓扑的算法化设计；有限密钥分析揭示当前启发式隐私放大可能超过有限密钥界，而采用纠错替代检测后丢弃可显著改善有限密钥性能，尤其有利于长距离链路。

title: Implementation of a 1D Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD under finite-size parameter estimation
summary: Continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) is a promising technology for quantum-secure communications, offering high secret-key rates and straightforward integration with coherent optical communication systems. Conventional Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD encodes information in both optical-field quadratures, increasing requirements for state preparation, modulation, and calibration, while potentially introducing additional preparation imperfections. Unidimensional (1D) Gaussian modulation offers a simpler alternative by encoding information in only one quadrature, while the conjugate quadrature constrains the protocol's security. However, an integrated experimental 1D implementation combining independent-laser coherent reception with practical reconciliation, finite-size parameter estimation, and privacy amplification remains challenging. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a 1D Gaussian-modulated CV-QKD system over 12~km of standard single-mode fiber using a local local oscillator (LLO) architecture with independent lasers and an integrated offline classical post-processing chain. The implementation includes coherent detection, digital signal processing, information reconciliation, parameter estimation, physicality-constrained security analysis, and privacy amplification. The 1D system achieves a privacy-amplified rate of $1.421$~Mbit/s under the asymptotic security treatment and $0.364$~Mbit/s under the finite-size scenario. These results establish an experimental baseline for the performance--complexity trade-off associated with unidimensional Gaussian modulation and provide an experimental basis for developing lower-complexity CV-QKD transmitters.

AI.tldr: 本文在12 km标准单模光纤上实验实现基于独立激光器LLO架构的一维高斯调制CV-QKD，并完成相干检测、离线后处理与隐私放大，获得渐近1.421 Mbit/s和有限码长0.364 Mbit/s的隐私放大码率。
AI.motivation: 传统高斯调制CV-QKD同时在光场两个正交分量上编码信息，会增加态制备、调制与校准要求，并可能引入额外制备缺陷；一维高斯调制仅在一个正交分量编码，可降低复杂度，但结合独立激光器相干接收、实用协调、有限码长参数估计和隐私放大的集成实验实现仍具挑战。
AI.method: 采用一维高斯调制CV-QKD系统，在12 km标准单模光纤上使用本地本振（LLO）架构和独立激光器，并集成离线经典后处理链；处理环节包括相干检测、数字信号处理、信息协调、参数估计、物理性约束安全性分析以及隐私放大，并分别给出渐近安全和有限码长情形下的结果。
AI.result: 该系统实现的隐私放大码率为：渐近安全处理下1.421 Mbit/s，有限码长情形下0.364 Mbit/s；实验光纤长度为12 km标准单模光纤。
AI.conclusion: 结果为一维高斯调制在性能与复杂度权衡方面建立了实验基线，并为开发更低复杂度的CV-QKD发射端提供了实验依据。

title: Reflection Zeros Set the Scattering Invariant of Finite Majorana Wires
summary: Majorana modes, zero-energy excitations of superconducting wires that are their own antiparticles, could store quantum information protected from local noise. In transport experiments, however, ordinary bound states mimic their signature, a conductance peak at zero voltage, and whether Majorana modes have been observed remains debated. A sign, $Q$, of the electron reflection at zero energy marks the topological phase of a long wire, but what $Q$ certifies in a finite device has been unclear. Here we show for the first time that $Q$ counts reflectionless states, waves that enter through one contact and leave entirely through the other: $Q=-1$ when an odd number of them lie in the lower half of the complex energy plane. In a finite wire this means that the two Majorana modes are split by less than their coupling to the contacts. With equal contacts, every sign change of $Q$, including the bulk topological transition, is an exceptional point at which two such states merge and transmission is maximally flat. At zero temperature, $Q=-1$ exactly when the zero-bias conductance measured at a contact exceeds $e^2/h$. These results show what transport can certify about a Majorana device and how to read the invariant from conductance.

AI.tldr: 该文澄清有限长度超导器件中零能电子反射符号 Q 的物理含义：Q 计数无反射态，并可在零温下由零偏压电导是否超过 e^2/h 读出，从而判断 Majorana 模式是否受拓扑保护。
AI.motivation: Majorana 模式有望用于抗局域噪声的量子信息存储，但其零偏压电导峰会被普通束缚态模仿，是否已观测到仍存争议；长导线中 Q 标志拓扑相，但 Q 在有限器件中究竟认证什么尚不明确。
AI.method: 摘要未提供具体模型、数值或实验细节；可见的方法是对零能电子反射符号 Q 进行理论分析，将其与无反射态在复能量平面下半平面的奇偶数目、有限导线中 Majorana 模式分裂与接触耦合的相对大小、等接触条件下的异常点及零温零偏压电导联系起来。
AI.result: 研究表明 Q 计数无反射态：当奇数个无反射态位于复能量平面下半平面时 Q=-1；在有限导线中，这意味着两个 Majorana 模式的分裂小于它们与接触的耦合。等接触时，Q 的每次符号变化（包括体拓扑转变）都是异常点，两个此类态合并且透射最大程度平坦。零温下，Q=-1 当且仅当接触处测得的零偏压电导超过 e^2/h。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果明确了输运测量能够对 Majorana 器件认证什么，并给出了从电导读取拓扑不变量的方法。

title: Lorentz Boosts and Governing Equations of the Quantum Geometric Tensor in 4D Energy-Momentum Space
summary: In solids, the quantum geometric tensor (QGT), $Q_{μν}=g_{μν}-\frac{i}{2} Ω_{μν}$, combines the quantum metric and Berry curvature. Its imaginary part governs anomalous velocity and quantized Hall transport, while its real part determines the quantum weight and geometric contributions to flat-band superfluid stiffness and dielectric response. Here, we extend the QGT to four-dimensional (4D) energy-momentum space ($ω/c,k$), treating frequency and momentum as independent coordinates. Invariance of the real-spacetime plane-wave phase fixes their Lorentz transformation in energy-momentum space. Lorentz boosts of static Dirac and Weyl systems then generate frequency metrics, quadrupolar frequency-momentum shear metrics, and electric-like Berry-Maxwell fields. We identify five Lorentz-invariant contractions and derive the governing field equations and flow conservation laws for both the quantum metric and Berry curvature from static Weyl geometry and Lorentz covariance. We further connect Gaussian spectral amplitudes of the QGT to localized Gaussian events in 4D spacetime. Finally, we discuss experimental realizations in spacetime crystals or time-varying media and clarify how this unified quantum geometry of a gravitational-like metric and electromagnetic-like gauge fields connects geometric self-consistency with physical event dynamics.

AI.tldr: 论文将量子几何张量推广到四维能量-动量空间，利用洛伦兹协变性从静态Dirac/Weyl体系生成频率度规、频率-动量剪切度规和Berry-Maxwell场，并给出量子度规与Berry曲率的场方程、流守恒律及高斯谱与时空事件的对应，讨论时空晶体或时变介质中的实验实现。
AI.motivation: 量子几何张量统一量子度规与Berry曲率：其虚部支配反常速度和量子化霍尔输运，实部决定量子权重以及平带超流刚度、介电响应中的几何贡献。作者希望把频率与动量视为独立坐标，在四维能量-动量空间中建立统一量子几何，以连接类引力度规与类电磁规范场。
AI.method: 基于实空间平面波相位不变性确定能量-动量空间的洛伦兹变换；对静态Dirac和Weyl体系作洛伦兹助推；构造五个洛伦兹不变收缩；从静态Weyl几何和洛伦兹协变性推导量子度规与Berry曲率的场方程及流守恒律；将量子几何张量的高斯谱振幅与四维时空中的局域高斯事件联系；并讨论时空晶体或时变介质中的实验实现。
AI.result: 得到洛伦兹助推产生的频率度规、四极频率-动量剪切度规和电性Berry-Maxwell场；识别出五个洛伦兹不变收缩；给出量子度规与Berry曲率的支配场方程和流守恒律；建立量子几何张量高斯谱振幅与四维时空局域高斯事件的对应。摘要未提供具体材料参数、定量实验数据或数值验证结果。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出一个四维量子几何统一框架，将类引力度规与类电磁规范场联系起来，并把几何自洽性与物理事件动力学相连接；时空晶体或时变介质被视为可能的实验实现平台。摘要未给出具体实验方案细节或定量结论。

title: Hong$-$Ou$-$Mandel-like interference between two independent narrowband thermal states
summary: Narrowband photonic sources are promising candidates in quantum networks for a direct interface with atomic quantum memories. However, building a large-scale quantum network requires many indistinguishable sources, and matching the frequencies of independent narrowband sources is generally challenging. Here, we propose a method to measure the frequency difference between two narrowband light sources in the single-photon power regime by studying Hong$-$Ou$-$Mandel-like (HOM) interference between thermal states. Our results show that the absolute value of the frequency difference can be extracted from the temporal coincidence counts, and these results agree well with our theoretical model. We also demonstrate that the beat signal of the HOM-like interference between two thermal states has a similar oscillation profile to the HOM interference between two heralded single-photon sources, confirming that this method can be used to find the zero detuning of two heralded single-photon sources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种在单光子功率水平下，利用两个热态之间的HOM类干涉和时间符合计数来测量两个窄带光源频率差的方法；实验/观测结果与理论模型吻合，并表明该方法可用于寻找两个预报单光子源的零失谐点。
AI.motivation: 窄带光子源可与原子量子存储器直接接口，是量子网络的重要候选；但构建大规模量子网络需要大量不可区分光源，而独立窄带光源之间的频率匹配通常很困难，因此需要一种有效的频率差测量与零失谐确定方法。
AI.method: 提出通过研究两个热态之间的Hong-Ou-Mandel类干涉，在单光子功率区间测量两个窄带光源的频率差；从时间符合计数中提取频率差绝对值，并与理论模型比较；同时分析两个热态HOM类干涉的拍频信号，将其振荡轮廓与两个预报单光子源之间的HOM干涉进行比较。
AI.result: 结果表明，频率差的绝对值可从时间符合计数中提取，且与理论模型吻合良好；两个热态HOM类干涉的拍频信号具有与两个预报单光子源HOM干涉相似的振荡轮廓，证实该方法可用于寻找两个预报单光子源的零失谐。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种在单光子功率水平下测量窄带光源频率差并确定零失谐的方法，有望用于实现独立窄带光子源的频率匹配；摘要未提供频率差测量精度、可测范围或实验细节。

title: Non-Convex Optimization via Quantum Tunneling Search on a Photonic Chip
summary: Non-convex optimization plays an important role in modern machine learning since plenty of real-world problems have objective functions or constraints with non-convex properties. The non-convex nature of landscapes gives rise to numerous local minima and saddle points, dramatically hindering the ability of gradient descent-based methods to explore the landscape and obtain global optima. Here we present quantum tunneling search (QTS), an algorithm based on quantum tunneling walk and local annealing, which effectively explores the non-convex landscape by leveraging the quantum tunneling effect. In experiments, we map an objective function to the potential term of the waveguide Hamiltonian by controlling the refractive index with the femtosecond direct laser writing technique. With a proper input state, the average probability distributions on 10-micrometer-spaced 29 x 1 and 21 x 9 waveguide arrays highlight the local minima of various 1D and 2D non-convex landscapes, respectively. By further introducing the varying Hamiltonian approach, more efficient search and even the identification of the global minimum are achieved. Our work experimentally verifies that QTS is a successful and efficient non-convex optimization solver, demonstrating quantum speedups over classical stochastic gradient descent (SGD), which serves as a practical application of near-term analog quantum simulators in the field of machine learning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出量子隧穿搜索（QTS），将量子隧穿行走与局部退火结合，并在飞秒激光直写波导阵列中实验实现，用于探索非凸优化景观；在1D和2D案例中定位局部极小，并通过变化哈密顿量方法提升搜索效率、甚至识别全局最小，声称相对经典随机梯度下降（SGD）具有量子加速。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习中大量实际问题具有非凸目标函数或约束，非凸景观产生众多局部极小与鞍点，显著阻碍基于梯度下降的方法探索景观并获得全局最优，因此需要有效的非凸优化求解器，并探索近期模拟量子模拟器在机器学习中的实际应用。
AI.method: 提出基于量子隧穿行走和局部退火的QTS算法，利用量子隧穿效应探索非凸景观。实验中通过飞秒直写激光技术控制折射率，将目标函数映射为波导哈密顿量的势项，在10微米间距的29 x 1和21 x 9波导阵列上，以适当输入态获得平均概率分布；进一步引入变化哈密顿量方法。具体目标函数形式、退火 schedule 与实验误差等细节未提供。
AI.result: 平均概率分布分别凸显多种1D和2D非凸景观的局部极小；引入变化哈密顿量方法后，实现更高效搜索并甚至识别全局最小。实验验证QTS是成功且高效的非凸优化求解器，并展示相对经典SGD的量子加速；具体加速比、基准设置与统计指标未提供。
AI.conclusion: QTS可作为有效的非凸优化求解器，并展示了近期模拟量子模拟器在机器学习领域的实际应用潜力。

title: Reply to the Comment by Hradil and Řeháček
summary: Hradil and Řeháček argue that the quantum metrological advantage demonstrated in our squeezed-vacuum phase-sensing experiment disappears, when measurement repetitions and total photon resources are properly accounted for. We show that this conclusion is mathematically unfounded and that neither resource accounting nor finite-sample statistical considerations invalidate the demonstrated quantum-enhanced local phase sensitivity.

AI.conclusion: 该质疑不成立，压缩真空相位传感实验所展示的量子增强局域相位灵敏度在正确计入资源及有限样本统计后仍然有效。

title: Comprehensive quantum electrodynamics of fast electrons interacting with dissipative nanostructures and quantum light
summary: Theoretical descriptions of the quantum electrodynamical interaction between fast electrons and nanostructures conventionally rely on standard macroscopic quantum electrodynamics (MQED), which, when applied to bounded objects in vacuum, formally requires an asymptotic limiting procedure to account for free-space radiation modes. To explicitly incorporate these modes from the outset, we employ the modified Langevin noise formalism (MLNF), which independently quantizes both the asymptotic scattering modes and the electromagnetic field generated by dissipative material sources. Utilizing an exact second-order Magnus expansion, we derive a closed-form, nonperturbative master formula for the transverse-momentum-resolved energy exchange probability. In the unilluminated regime, we demonstrate that at finite nanostructure temperatures, the vacuum scattering and thermal material fluctuations do not mathematically recombine into the total imaginary part of the dyadic Green's function. This breakdown does not violate the Fluctuation-Dissipation Theorem, because the explicit zero-temperature scattering field acts as an independent dynamical system that maintains the configuration out of global thermodynamic equilibrium. This fundamental separation reveals an intrinsic Stokes--Anti-Stokes asymmetry, yielding distinct transverse diffraction patterns for energy loss and thermal energy gain, and establishing a generalized detailed-balance relation that governs the radiative reduction of the apparent temperature in nanoscale electron thermometry. In the illuminated regime, our framework rigorously incorporates quantum-optical states into macroscopic dissipative electrodynamics, demonstrating that...

AI.tldr: 该文用修正朗之万噪声形式（MLNF）与二阶马格努斯展开，建立非微扰的横向动量分辨能量交换概率公式，揭示真空散射模与热材料涨落的不可简单合并性、斯托克斯—反斯托克斯不对称及广义细致平衡关系，并扩展到光照射下的量子光学态。

AI.method: 采用修正朗之万噪声形式（MLNF），分别量子化渐近散射模和耗散材料源产生的电磁场；利用精确的二阶马格努斯展开，推导横向动量分辨的能量交换概率的闭式非微扰主公式。

title: Non-Bloch Topology of Frustrated Non-Hermitian Flat Bands
summary: Frustrated lattices with exactly flat bands and compact localized states provide an ideal setting to uncover the topology of flat bands, leading to intriguing physics in two dimensions. Extending from Hermitian to non-Hermitian systems, however, band structures are drastically changed by the non-Hermitian skin effect, which is less well understood beyond one dimension. Here, we construct a broad class of two-dimensional frustrated non-Hermitian lattice models with exactly flat bands which can be naturally described in a non-Bloch band theory. Using non-Hermitian breathing Kagome and checkerboard models as illustrations, we reveal how flat bands acquire a basis-independent skin effect induced by the other bands; in the breathing Kagome model it appears exactly when the flat band enters the area spanned by the periodic-boundary spectra of the dispersive bands. A flat band becomes singular when its eigenvectors hold immovable discontinuities at band crossings. Such singularity in non-Hermitian systems is sensitive to boundary conditions and unprotected by band flatness. Non-Bloch topology underlying is uncovered in a bulk-boundary correspondence with the formation of a singular band touching in the bulk and a robust flat band skin mode on the boundary. We present a geometric approach to construct this boundary skin mode from a macroscopic sum of compact localized skin modes and trace its topological origin to two linearly independent noncontractible loop states on a non-Bloch torus. To characterize the correspondence, an invariant is proposed based on biorthogonal polarization of the zero-energy corner mode. Breaking exact flatness, we further realize nearly flat non-Bloch Chern bands.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一类具有精确平带的二维阻挫非厄米晶格模型，并在非Bloch能带理论框架下研究其平带趋肤效应、奇异性、非Bloch拓扑及体边对应；以非厄米呼吸Kagome和棋盘模型为例，揭示了由其他能带诱导的基无关平带趋肤效应、平带奇异化条件、边界趋肤模的几何构造与拓扑起源，并提出基于零能角模双正交极化的不变量。
AI.motivation: 阻挫晶格中的精确平带和紧局域态为研究二维平带拓扑提供了理想平台；但将体系从厄米推广到非厄米后，非厄米趋肤效应会显著改变能带结构，而其在二维及平带情形下的理解仍不足，因此需要建立可描述二维阻挫非厄米平带的非Bloch能带理论。
AI.method: 构造一大类具有精确平带的二维阻挫非厄米晶格模型，并采用非Bloch能带理论描述；以非厄米呼吸Kagome模型和棋盘模型为具体例子，分析平带趋肤效应、能带交叉处本征矢的不连续性与奇异性；通过体边对应研究非Bloch拓扑，提出从紧局域趋肤模的宏观求和构造边界趋肤模的几何方法，并基于零能角模的双正交极化提出拓扑不变量；进一步通过破坏精确平带性构造近平面非Bloch Chern带。
AI.result: 研究发现平带可获得由其他能带诱导的基无关趋肤效应；在呼吸Kagome模型中，该效应恰在平带进入色散带周期边界谱所张成区域时出现。当本征矢在能带交叉处具有不可移动不连续时，平带变为奇异，且这种奇异性对边界条件敏感，并不受能带平坦性保护。体边对应表现为体内奇异能带接触与边界上稳健平带趋肤模的形成；边界趋肤模可由紧局域趋肤模的宏观求和构造，其拓扑起源可追溯为非Bloch环面上的两个线性无关非可收缩环态。基于零能角模双正交极化的不变量被用于刻画该对应关系；破坏精确平带性后还可实现近平面非Bloch Chern带。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为二维阻挫非厄米体系中的精确平带提供了非Bloch能带理论描述，揭示了平带趋肤效应、奇异性与非Bloch拓扑之间的联系，并建立了包含奇异体内能带接触和稳健边界平带趋肤模的体边对应；所提几何构造与双正交极化不变量为表征相关拓扑提供了途径，且该框架可推广到近平面非Bloch Chern带。摘要未提供具体模型参数、数值细节或实验验证信息。

title: Exact transformation-optics representation of the Ellis wormhole and limits of finite-device scattering emulation
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Ancillary files contain the Python and MATLAB codes and the data needed to reproduce all figures and tables
summary: We derive a global isotropic representation of the ultrastatic Ellis wormhole and establish which features of its electromagnetic response can, and cannot, be reproduced by a finite device. An orientation-preserving coordinate map sends the signed proper-radial line to a punctured Euclidean chart with refractive index $n(ρ)=1+a^2/(4ρ^2)$. Through the Plebański correspondence, this gives the exact impedance-matched continuum medium $\varepsilon_r=μ_r=n(ρ)\,\mathbb{1}$ and its full vector-Maxwell operator. For the ideal two-ended geometry, we derive the electromagnetic radial operator, establish its spectral properties, and express its scattering amplitudes through Jost solutions and Wronskians. Nonzero transmission into the second asymptotic end implies $|R_{\rm id}|<1$ at every real frequency, whereas a regular, lossless finite one-port has unit-modulus reflection. The reverse triangle inequality therefore yields a strictly positive lower bound on the complex reflection-amplitude mismatch. This theorem applies to the stated lossless single-port class and is not extended to lossy or multiport realizations. We compute converged multipole scattering data and establish the low-frequency threshold scaling $|T_L|^2\propto(ωa/c)^{4L+2}$, with coefficients independently validated for $L=1,2,3,4$. The transmission cross section tends to $πa^2$, while the ideal profile's total scattering cross section has a logarithmic forward divergence. We also construct a smooth finite-shell target and derive an exact finite-band constitutive-error formula for a calibrated passive Lorentz model. The constitutive benchmark is kept distinct from scattering equivalence throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文给出超静态 Ellis 虫洞的全局各向同性表示，并通过 Plebański 对应得到精确阻抗匹配连续介质及其矢量 Maxwell 算子；证明理想双端虫洞与无损有限单端口在复反射振幅上存在严格正的下界失配，同时给出多极透射阈值标度、截面性质及有限壳层本构误差基准。
AI.motivation: 推导超静态 Ellis 虫洞的全局各向同性表示，并判定其电磁响应中哪些特征可由有限器件复现、哪些不能。
AI.method: 采用保向坐标映射将带符号固有径向线送至去心欧氏坐标图，得到折射率 n(ρ)=1+a^2/(4ρ^2)；经 Plebański 对应构造精确阻抗匹配连续介质 ε_r=μ_r=n(ρ)𝟙 及完整矢量 Maxwell 算子。对理想双端几何推导电磁径向算子，建立谱性质，并用 Jost 解与 Wronskian 表示散射振幅；计算收敛的多极散射数据；构造光滑有限壳层目标，并对校准无源 Lorentz 模型推导精确有限频带本构误差公式。
AI.result: 理想双端几何中进入第二渐近端的非零透射导致所有实频率下 |R_id|<1，而正则无损有限单端口具有单位模反射；由反向三角不等式得到复反射振幅失配的严格正下界。该定理仅适用于所述无损单端口类，不推广至有损或多端口实现。低频谱阈值标度为 |T_L|^2∝(ωa/c)^{4L+2}，系数对 L=1,2,3,4 独立验证；透射截面趋于 πa^2，理想剖面的总散射截面具有前向对数发散。有限壳层与 Lorentz 模型给出有限频带本构误差公式，且本构基准与散射等价性保持区分。
AI.conclusion: 理想虫洞的电磁响应不能由无损有限单端口完全复现，复反射振幅存在严格正失配下界；所建立表示、散射结果和本构误差基准为有限器件可实现性提供了判据，但结论不延伸至有损或多端口实现。摘要未提供具体实验验证或材料参数细节。

title: Towards Distributed Quantum Computing: Quantum Gate Teleportation via Satellite-Distributed Entanglement under Atmospheric Depolarization
summary: We investigate quantum gate teleportation as a primitive for satellite-enabled distributed quantum computing. In the considered architecture, a satellite distributes entangled photon pairs to two optical ground stations, which transfer the shared quantum resource to remote quantum processing units. This entanglement is then used to implement a nonlocal controlled-NOT gate between two circuit qubits located in different processors. We formulate the minimal four-qubit protocol, consisting of two network qubits that provide the entangled resource and two circuit qubits on which the distributed gate is performed. Atmospheric propagation effects in the gravitational field are modeled through an effective two-qubit depolarizing channel whose parameters depend on atmospheric and optical quantities, including the Fried parameter and receiver aperture. The performance of the protocol is quantified by the fidelity between the ideal CNOT output state and the state produced by noisy quantum gate teleportation. Our results show that the fidelity is governed by the quality of the distributed entanglement and depends jointly on atmospheric coherence, aperture size, and effective depolarization strength. These findings connect physical-layer modeling of satellite optical channels with gate-level performance in distributed quantum computing.

AI.tldr: 该文研究以量子门隐形传态作为卫星分布式量子计算原语：卫星向两个光学地面站分发纠缠光子对，并将共享纠缠传递至远程量子处理器，以实现跨处理器的非局域CNOT门。作者构建最小四量子比特协议，用有效二量子比特去极化信道刻画引力场中的大气传播，并以理想CNOT输出与含噪量子门隐形传态输出之间的保真度评估性能。
